GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.name: Outpost
GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.description:
Structure claiming a Province for its owner and forming the foundation for a new City.

An outpost can:Be built by a Hero.Must be in a land or water province.Cannot be built in an Uninhabitable province.Cannot be built adjacent to a province with another outpost or city.Be upgraded into a City if on land.Has various upgrades that can be built on it.Not be entered by enemies without trespassing.Grant access to Magic Material.Provide income from Resource Node in the domain when a City establishes a Trade Route to it.

GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.name: Affinity Province Improvement
GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.description: Affinity Province Improvements are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement. Only one can be built per City, and an Empire can only build one of each. If the Seed, Root and Heart of the same affinity have been built in the Empire, the Magic Victory Spell is unlocked.

GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.name: Accuracy
GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.description: Accuracy is the likelihood of attacks landing successfully. If the attack does not land, it misses or grazes the target.<bulletlist><bullet>Grazes deal half damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses deal no damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses can hit random adjacent units next to the target.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.name: Action Point
GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.description:
Unit use Action Points to attack and use abilities.Units get 3 Action Points per Turn, and can use up to 2 of them to move.
Abilities use action points in different ways: Ability costs a single action point. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability triggers once per remaining action point. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability costs 3 action points. The unit's turn ends afterwards. Ability costs 0 action points. Ability costs 0 action points. The unit retains 1 action point afterwards. Ability requires 3 action points. The unit retains 1 action point afterwards.

GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.name: Base Attack
GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.description:
A base attack is a normal attack that a unit can usually use every turn in combat.

Some Unit Enchantment only affect a unit's base attacks.

GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.name: Casualty
GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.description:
When a Unit sustains damage, members of the unit are lost.

Each member lost lowers the damage output of the unit proportionally. The chance for the unit to apply Negative Status Effect is also reduced.

A Ruler or Hero unit and large monsters only have a single member and are not affected by this rule.

GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.name: Charge
GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.description:
A Charge attack:Gains extra damage per hex traveled, up to 3 hexes.Cancels Defense Mode.Removes Retaliation Attack.
These effects are negated by Charge Resistance, unless the attack is a Heavy Charge Strike.

GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.name: Combat Speed
GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.description: Combat Speed represents how far a unit can move within a Turn in Combat.Each hex in combat costs 1 point to traverse.Slowing terrain costs 2 points to traverse.

GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.name: Control Loss Immunity
GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.description:
Immune to effects that make you lose control of a unit, such as Berserk and Dominated.
Also grants immunity to being Captured.

GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.name: Critical Hit
GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.description: If a unit's attack is a Critical Hit, its damage is increased by +50%.Critical Hits are usually caused by high Morale.Critical Hit chance can never be higher than an attack's chance to hit.

GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.name: Debuff
GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.description: An ability that attempts to inflict a Negative Status Effect on an enemy without directly dealing damage.

GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.name: Defense
GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.description: Defense reduces damage from Melee and Missile attacks.

GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.name: Defense Mode
GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.description: Defense Mode is a Unit ability. When in Defense Mode, a unit:Extends its Zone of Control to all adjacent hexes.Gains +2 Defense.Gains +2 Resistance.Is immune to Flanking.

GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.name: Engaged in Melee
GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.description: While within an enemy's Zone of Control, a unit is Engaged in Melee and cannot use most ranged attacks or magical abilities.

GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.name: Evasion
GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.description: Increases chance of Missile and ranged Magic attacks missing.

GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.name: Experience
GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.description:
Experience points are earned by units to allow them to reach higher ranks, improving their abilities.

Units earn experience from winning battles. They also earn a small amount each turn on the world map.

GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.name: First Strike
GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.description: When attacked, a unit with First Strike will use a Retaliation Attack to attack first.

GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.name: Flanking
GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.description: Flanking attacks are triggered by attacking a target from behind or from the side.Flanking attacks deal +25% damage.Units in Defense Mode cannot be flanked.If a unit starts its turn in an enemy's Zone of Control, then it cannot flank it in that turn.

GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.name: Fortified
GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.description: Can only be damaged by abilities or spells that have Demolisher.

GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.name: Fumble
GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.description: If a unit's attack is a Fumble:A hit becomes a Graze, dealing half damage.A graze becomes a miss.Fumbles are usually caused by low Morale.

GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.name: Hero Ambitions
GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.description:
Each Hero has an Ambition, which sets goals for them to complete and gain Renown. Each includes a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing these ambitions grants Renown, while completing the Major Ambition additionally grants a unique hero property.

A hero's Ambition may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete their goals in a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroClass.name: Hero Class
GLOBAL.HeroClass.description:
Each Hero has a Class, chosen during creation. Each class lets the hero specialize in particular roles and often supports two general variations on that role.

Hero Classes:Hero Class: DefenderHero Class: WarriorHero Class: ElementalistHero Class: RitualistHero Class: RangerHero Class: Death KnightHero Class: Spellblade

GLOBAL.HeroDedication.name: Hero Signature Skills
GLOBAL.HeroDedication.description:
At certain levels, heroes gain the ability to choose Signature skills. For Champion, Wizard King, and Dragon Lords, these take the form of Affinity Dedications.

Each tier of Affinity dedication becomes available based on the Affinity of your empire and your hero's level:
Initiate - Requires 1 affinity point and a level 4 Hero.Adept - Requires 3 affinity points and a level 8 Hero.Master - Requires 6 affinity points and a level 12 Hero. Paragon - Requires 8 affinity points and a level 16 Hero.

These Dedications grant a benefit of their own and unlock new Hero Skills.

Some Hero types such as Eldritch Sovereigns have special Signature Skills that are not related to affinity.

GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.name: Destiny
GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.description:
Each Hero has a Destiny, which sets goals for the hero to complete to gain Renown. Each Destiny has a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing Ambitions grants Renown, and completing Major Ambitions grants a unique hero property as well.

A Hero's destiny may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete its ambitions for a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.name: Hero Origin
GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.description:
The Origin is determined by the type of hero made during faction creation; for most randomly encountered Hero this will be Champion.

This is where skills unique to those types are found, such as breath attacks for Dragon Lords or spell enchantments for Wizard King.

GLOBAL.RenownConcept.name: Hero Renown
GLOBAL.RenownConcept.description:
Heroes gain Renown as they complete the goals associated with their Ambition. Gaining enough renown increases their Renown Level, which increases the bonuses their Governed City gains from the hero's Governance trait.
Additionally, renown levels grant units in the hero's army additional morale and reduce the chance of losing units when Routing.

GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.name: Death Knight
GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in high damage Melee attacks, backed up by Debuff and summoned Undead units.

Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmisher Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.name: Defender
GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in defending its allies, survivability, and retaliation.

Compatible weapons:One Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmisher Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.name: Elementalist
GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.description:
Elementalists are magical damage dealers setting up attacks or delivering the killing blow with powerful Elemental abilities.
Each Elementalist hero chooses a discipline which determines the element of their abilities.

Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger.name: Ranger
GLOBAL.HeroClassRanger.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in ranged damage, skirmishing, and disrupting enemies.

Compatible weapons:Ranged WeaponSkirmisher Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.name: Ritualist
GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in support through healing and buffs.

Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.name: Spellblade
GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.description:
A Hero Class that uses both Melee and Magic attacks to deal magic damage from a distance and physical damage when the enemy gets close.

Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmisher WeaponRanged Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.name: Warlock
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.description:
Warlocks are debuff and undeath experts, using powerful debuffs and empowering undead summons they raise during battle.

Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.name: Warrior
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.description:
A Hero Class that specializes in charge attacks, dealing damage, and gaining strength through fighting.

Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmisher Weapon

GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.name: Adept Hero Skill
GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.description: Adept skills are unlocked by acquiring 2 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.name: Expert Hero Skill
GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.description: Expert skills are unlocked by acquiring 4 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.name: Master Hero Skill
GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.description: Master skills are unlocked by acquiring 6 other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.name: Hit Point
GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.description: Hit Points represent the amount of damage a Unit can sustain before it dies.Most units will take Casualty as their Hit Points drop.

GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.name: Line of Sight
GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.description: Most ranged attacks need Line of Sight to target an enemy.If obstacles or other Unit are between the attacker and the target, the target becomes Obscured, reducing Accuracy.Units adjacent to the attacker do not cause a target to be Obscured.

GLOBAL.MagicConcept.name: Magic
GLOBAL.MagicConcept.description:
Magic Attacks are attacks performed with magical implements such as orbs and staves.

Many of the special attacks that creatures have, such as dragon's breath, are also considered Magic attacks.

Magic attacks are resisted by Resistance.

GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.name: Melee
GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.description:
Melee attacks are short ranged attacks performed with weapons such as swords, spears, claws and teeth.

They mostly do Physical Damage and are resisted by Defense.

GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.name: Hero Mount
GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.description:
Mounts can be equipped by Hero in the relevant slot.
They generally grant Fast Movement and a small increase in Hit Point.
Certain powerful weapons cannot be wielded while mounted.
The mount that the Hero starts with depends on their race and any form traits that race may have.

GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.name: Movement Ability
GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.description:
An ability that moves the unit using it to another location.

Cannot be used by units that are Immobilized.
Cannot be used when on water unless also a Teleport.

GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.name: Move Point
GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.description: Move Points represent how far a unit can move within a Turn on the World Map.Normal terrain costs 6 Move Points to traverse.Sometimes the Move Point cost of terrain can be reduced, such as when moving through your Domain, but it can never be reduced below 2 Move Points.In Combat Move Points are not used, Combat Speed is used instead.

GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.name: Negative Status Effect
GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.description:
A negative status effect is a temporary condition that weakens a unit in some way. They are often applied by << Debuff Spell>> and Debuff abilities.

Examples include:Sundered ResistancePoisonedDominatedDecaying
All cultures have a unit ability or spell that can remove negative status effects.

Additionally, some negative status effects have counters—for example, Poisoned can be removed by applying Regeneration.

GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.name: Non-Refreshable Abilities
GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.description: Abilities marked with "Can't be refreshed" cannot have their cooldowns and "once per battle" status reset in battle by special abilities such as Weaver.

GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.name: Obscured
GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.description: When a target is Obscured, it becomes 40% harder to hit with ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.name: Opportunity Attack
GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.description: Opportunity Attacks are a special type of Retaliation Attack that are triggered when an enemy unit leaves the Zone of Control.

GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.name: Positive Status Effect
GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.description:
A positive status effect is a temporary condition that strengthens a unit in some way. They are often applied by Buff Spell and Support abilities.

Examples include:Bolstered ResistanceRegenerationHastenedSteadfast
Certain rare unit abilities and spells can remove positive status effects.

Additionally, some positive status effects have counters—for example, Regeneration can be removed by applying Poisoned.

GLOBAL.RangeConcept.name: Range
GLOBAL.RangeConcept.description:
Range refers to the maximum number of hexes away from a unit that an ability can target.
Using attacks on a target at maximum range will often incur an Accuracy penalty.

GLOBAL.RangedConcept.name: Missile
GLOBAL.RangedConcept.description:
Missile attacks are medium to long ranged attacks performed with weapons such as bows or throwing knives.

They mostly do Physical Damage and are resisted by Defense.

GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.name: Resistance
GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.description: Resistance reduces damage from Magic attacks and Combat Spell.

GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.name: Retaliation Attack
GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.description: A Retaliation Attack is an attack triggered by another Unit's attacks or movementMelee units can Retaliate once per Turn (by default).Attacking an enemy unit within the Zone of Control triggers a Retaliation.An enemy unit moving out of the Zone of Control triggers an Opportunity Attack.

GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.name: Retreating
GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.description: When a Unit moves onto a Retreat Point during Combat, they will immediately exit the battle. Nearby friendly units will lose morale .The unit will lose Move Points after battle.Retreating your last unit will cause you to lose the battle.If you lose the battle, the unit will either die, or scatter and reappear at one of your cities after a few turns.

GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.name: Status Resistance
GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.description: Status Resistance reduces the chance that a unit will be affected by Negative Status Effect.

GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.name: Summoning Ability
GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.description: An ability that summons a unit during battle.

GLOBAL.SupportConcept.name: Support
GLOBAL.SupportConcept.description: An ability that heals or applies Positive Status Effect to friendly units.

GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.name: Teleport Ability
GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.description: An ability that instantly moves this unit to another location using magic.

GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.name: Temporary Hit Point
GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.description: Temporary Hit Points are given to a Unit when it is healed in Combat.When a Unit takes damage, Temporary Hit Points are lost first.When combat ends, all Temporary Hit Points are removed.

GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.name: Morale
GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.description:
Unit Morale represents willingness to battle.
High Morale increases Critical Hit Chance.Low Morale increases Fumble chance in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map.Very Low Morale further increases Fumble chance and can lead to Routing Unit in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map .
Morale States:High MoraleNeutral MoraleLow Morale.Very Low MoraleRouting

GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.name: Unit Tier
GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.description: Unit Tier represents its relative strength in Combat.Higher tier Unit have a higher per turn Unit Upkeep.Tier 3+ Units gain Status Resistance which increases for higher Tiers.Unit Tiers range from 1 to 5.Hero are treated as Tier 5 for relevant skills and abilities.

GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.name: World Map Regeneration
GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.description:
Units recover a certain number of Hit Point each Turn when not in combat.

The amount of hit points regained is higher when the unit is in your Domain near one of your City or Outpost. Being in enemy domain or in the territory of a Infestation reduces regeneration.

World Map Regeneration can also be increased by certain Hero Skills and Empire Skill.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.name: Bounty
GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.description:
Bounties are Ruler created quests that can be offered to other Rulers in exchange for a reward. Other non-hostile Rulers may choose to accept the bounty. The Ruler that completes the objective first will receive the reward and complete the bounty.

Rulers receive 20 Turn to complete the bounty. If the time runs out before the objective is completed, then they fail the bounty. While the Bounty target is being sieged or an operation is active, the timer will pause. The timer will also not run out if an AI Ruler is actively attempting the bounty.

The bounty cannot be canceled while any Ruler is attempting it after the turn in which it was created. If the bounty fails during this time, it will return 50% of the reward.

In order to create a bounty and have other Rulers accept it, specific requirements must be met.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.name: Bounty Requirements
GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.description:
In order to create a Bounty, you must be at War with another Ruler or Free City. Possible bounty targets are:CityOutpostBound Ancient WonderBeacons of UnityOccupied Seals
A Viability is determined for each other ruler which determines whether they can accept your bounty or not. Rulers may accept up to 3 Bounty from another ruler at any time.

GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.name: Call to war
GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.description:
Ruler may call each other into War with a Ruler who they themselves are already at war with.

The Rulers must share at least a Wizard's Bond to send a call to war. The receiving Ruler may choose to accept or decline the call. Accepting gives them a Grievance bonus, whereas declining will result in considerable relations penalties.

GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.name: Grievance
GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.description:
Grievances determine your War Justification against other Ruler. They are your reason for going to war.

Obtained primarily by:Seeing a trespasser.Having another Ruler build on a Province you've claimed.Fabricating a Grievance.Being attacked.
Grievances can be exchanged for Resource with the Ruler they're held against.

GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.name: Rival Justification
GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.description:
Rival justification is a one-sided War Justification that allows you to ignore the opponent's Grievance points up to the same amount as your Rival Justification when declaring War on them.
The opposing Ruler is not affected by your Rival Justification when they declare war on you, nor are you affected by their Rival Justification.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.name: War Justification
GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.description:
War Justification is the balance of Grievance between two Ruler and is used to determine the impact of declaring War.

When starting a War:Alignment may be affected. Imperium income may be affected.Non-allied rulers can receive Grievance.Empire Relations with other Rulers as well as relations with (Vassal)Cities may be affected.
The following War Justification levels can be reached:Major (51+)Moderate (50 to 26 )Minor (25 to 1 )None (0 )Unjust (-1 to -25 )Very unjust (-26 to -50 )Completely unjust (-51 )

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.name: War Justification: None
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.description:
With no War Justification (0 ), declaring War becomes more damaging to your Empire.

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your Imperium income by -20% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.name: War Justification: Minor
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.description:
Having only minor War Justification (25 to 1 ), means that declaring War is justified but still frowned upon by other Ruler.

Wars are still considered an evil act and your Empire Relations with other Rulers will suffer a penalty.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.name: War Justification: Moderate
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.description: With Moderate War Justification (50 to 26 ), declaring War is now supported by your Vassal Cities as they gain a Relations bonus, and your Imperium income increases by 10 while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.name: War Justification: Major
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.description: With Major War Justification (51+), declaring War is fully justified. Your Vassal Cities gain a Relations bonus, and your Imperium income increases by 20 while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.name: War Justification: Unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.description:
With negative War Justification (-1 to -25 ), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your Imperium income by -40% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.name: War Justification: Very unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.description:
With negative War Justification (-26 to -50 ), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your Imperium income by -60% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.name: War Justification: Completely unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.description:
With completely negative War Justification (-51 ), declaring War can severely damage your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your Imperium income by -80% while the war lasts. When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.

GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.name: Fabricated Grievance
GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.description:
A fabricated Grievance is a Grievance about an event that did not actually happen but can still be used as a cause for War.

Ruler can only have one fabricated grievance against another Ruler and can use these to declare War or Denounce them. Fabricated Grievances can be sold to the opposing Ruler but cannot be forgiven.

Grievances can be fabricated through Pronouncement.

GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.name: Peace
GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.description: Peace is the default state of relations. Better terms are achieved through Negotiation, or War can be declared.

GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.name: Declaration of Friendship
GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.description:
Declare your Friendship with another Ruler publicly.

A modifier that slowly increases towards +300 will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Grievance gained against that Ruler will be reduced by -40%. When two Rulers declare Friendship with each other, each active diplomatic treaty they have increases the maximum relations bonus by +25 , up to +400 in total.

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 Gold upkeep per Turn, which increases by 10 Gold for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncement.

GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.name: Declaration of Rivalry
GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.description:
Declare a Rivalry with another Ruler publicly.

A modifier that slowly decreases towards -300 will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Grievance gained against that Ruler will be increased by 40%. However, making treaties becomes impossible and any existing treaties will be broken.

Additionally a rising Rival Justification modifier will be gained, which increases by 2 per Turn up to 30 .

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 Gold upkeep per Turn, which increases by 10 Gold for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncement.

GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.name: Pact of Cooperation
GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.description: The Free City opens its borders.A Trade Route can be established to this city from one of your own.Magic Material can be bought.

GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.name: Pact of Integration
GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.description: City ownership is given to the Empire forging this pact.Ceases to exist as a diplomatic entity.The Free City Lord can be recruited as a Hero of the Empire forging this pact.Any Whispering Stone will be released.

GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.name: Pact of Loyalty
GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.description: The Free City shares its vision.The Free City allows building on claimed provinces.Contributes 2 to the Rally of the Lieges.Will reinforce in Combat against Marauder and Ruler the Free City is at War with.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.name: Pact of Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.description: The Free City shares part of its Mana and Gold income as tribute.Magic Material they control are shared with their overlord.Other Empire may no longer negotiate better Diplomatic State with the Free City.The Free City will join its overlord in any War they are fighting, can assist in combat, and can be given directives in War Coordination.Switches to the Vassalage Phase, during which further Allegiance can be earned to improve the benefits of vassalage. Eventually the Free City may be integrated into the empire of its overlord.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.name: Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Rally of the Lieges.War Coordination is disabled and no new armies will be sent out.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.name: Minor Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Rally of the Lieges.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.name: Denying Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares none of its Magic Material.Contributes nothing to the Rally of the Lieges.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.name: Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide 10% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes 2 to the Rally of the Lieges.War Coordination becomes available.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.name: Bonded Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide 15% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes 3 to the Rally of the Lieges.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.name: Flourishing Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide 20% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes 4 to the Rally of the Lieges.City can be integrated .

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.name: Supreme Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.description: Trade Route with this Free City provide 25% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes 5 to the Rally of the Lieges.City can be integrated .

GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.name: Allegiance
GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.description:
Allegiance represents the commitment of a Free City to an Empire.

Allegiance is primarily gained by giving a Whispering Stone to the Free City Lord which starts Negotiation. Increasing allegiance will result in better Diplomatic State with the city, eventually leading to a Pact of Vassalage and Pact of Integration.

GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.name: Threat Level
GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.description:
The threat level represents how threatened other Ruler feel.

This level is influenced by many factors that look at how well each Ruler is doing: for example if they have large Army, many City, or are supported by many allies.

The threat level is expressed as a relations modifier.

GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.name: Pronouncements
GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.description: A statement or declaration that Ruler can make towards other Rulers to enhance their Relations. Includes fabricating Grievance, making declarations, Calling Rulers to War and more.

GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.name: Negotiation Phase of Free Cities
GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.description:
During the negotiation phase, all Empire may negotiate with a Free City for higher Allegiance and better diplomatic states. Once an Empire has secured enough Allegiance for a Pact of Vassalage, this competition ends and the \"winning\" Empire enters the Vassalage Phase.

These are the Diplomatic State of the Negotiation Phase: War Neutral Pact of Cooperation Pact of Loyalty Pact of Vassalage

GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.name: Vassalage Phase of Free Cities
GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.description:
During the vassalage phase, only the overlord Empire may negotiate with a Free City. Other Empire can only declare War on the Free City by declaring war on the Free City overlord.

These are the Diplomatic State of the Vassalage Phase:{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.Hyperlink}{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.Hyperlink}{GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.Hyperlink} Vassalage Bonded Vassalage Flourishing Vassalage Supreme Vassalage
Once Flourishing Vassalage is reached, the Pact of Integration becomes available, allowing an Empire to fully absorb the Free City.

GLOBAL.TruceConcept.name: Truce
GLOBAL.TruceConcept.description: Both Ruler vow not to attack each other while the truce lasts. War may still be declared, but counts as an evil act.

GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.name: Trespassing
GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.description:
Armies are considered to be trespassing when they are seen moving through the Province of another Ruler or Free City without having an open borders agreement.

Trespassing will give other Rulers a Grievance and damages the relation with free cities.

GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.name: Alliances
GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.description: The Ruler is less inclined toward hostile actions, is keen to act more in favor of good relations with other Rulers and cities and will not break their Alliances.

GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.name: Covert
GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.description: The Ruler is prone to making pronouncements and Calls to War more often, but is less eager to answer a call to war.

GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.name: Gaining vassals
GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.description: The Ruler favors gaining both cities and Rulers as vassals, but will not submit to becoming a vassal themselves.

GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.name: Hard bargains
GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.description: The Ruler likes to carry on Trade but tends to place more value on their own side of the deal. Other Rulers may have to sweeten their offers to make a deal happen.

GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.name: Isolation
GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.description: The Ruler does not easily want to commit to relations and is reluctant to answer Calls to War.

GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler engages in all forms of diplomacy to an equal degree as opportunities arise.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.name: Never breaks Treaty
GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler is committed to the Treaty they have with other Rulers and will always try to prevent them from being broken.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.name: Never Surrender
GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.description: The Ruler will not submit to becoming another Ruler's vassal. During War, they will not make peace of their own accord. They are more eager to call allies to war and will also more readily answer a Call to War.

GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.name: Wary of Treaties
GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.description: In general, the Ruler is not interested in having Treaty with other Rulers, making such trades more costly for the opposing side. They are reluctant to call another Ruler to war and to answer any incoming Calls to War.

GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.name: Trading
GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.description: The Ruler is keen on making Trade offers fairly often.

GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.name: Treaty
GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler prefers forming Treaty with other Rulers and will not break any treaties or Alliances they have.

GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.name: Vassalize the Strong
GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.description: The Ruler is tempted to make vassals of other strong Rulers.

GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.name: Driven by War
GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.description: The Ruler is easily provoked into going to War, even over minor Grievance. They will not sell or forgive any of their grievances and are more eager to send and answer a Call to War.

GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.name: War must be justified
GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.description: The Ruler will not go to War over minor Grievance and will want to justify their war.

GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.name: Personality Preference
GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.description:
Preferences are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determine which Actions or statuses they like or dislike other Rulers to pursue.

Relations with Rulers that conform to these preferences will receive a relation bonus, while Relations with Rulers that trigger Dislikes will incur a relation penalty.

GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.name: Strategy
GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.description: A Ruler's Strategy determines how they will act in terms of their Economy, Research, and Military, but also on a Diplomatic Level.

GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.name: Expansion
GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.description: The Ruler favors expanding their empire by building and absorbing cities. They focus on improving their cities and defending them.

GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.name: Exploitation
GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploiting all forms of resources near them and will hunt down Pickup, marauders and cities with their army. Captured cities will be migrated into their own population.

GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.name: Exploration
GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploring the map, seeking out potential resources such as Pickup and Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.name: Extermination
GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.description: The Ruler favors capturing resources using large armies rather than building them themselves and will raze other Rulers' cities that they have occupied.

GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler has no specific agenda or focus and acts more on the opportunities that present themselves.

GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.name: Pure Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.description: A knowledgeable Ruler who believes in mind over matter.

GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.name: Strategist Warlord
GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.description: An ambitious Ruler who values strategy and magical prowess.

GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.name: Erudite Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.description: A peaceful Ruler who values wisdom and learning.

GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.name: Militant Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.description: A power-hungry Ruler who believes that might makes right.

GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.name: Revolutionary Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.description: A rebellious Ruler who values both freedom and alliances.

GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.name: Demonic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.description: A bloodthirsty Ruler who prefers treachery to weakness.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.name: Competitive Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.description: A coin-savvy Ruler who is willing to trade... for the right price.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.name: Solitary Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.description: An isolated Ruler who believes in a strong defensive force.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.name: Artisan Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.description: An expressive creator who values both matter and mind.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.name: Economic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.description: A greedy Ruler who will stop at nothing to achieve economic goals.

GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.name: Persevering Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.description: A peace-keeping Ruler who believes in good relations.

GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.name: Harmonious Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.description: A forgiving Ruler who values alliances and exploration.

GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.name: Protective Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.description: A vigilant Ruler who prefers vassalization and magic.

GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.name: Chivalrous Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.description: An honorable Ruler who believes in justice and peace.

GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.name: Authoritarian Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.description: A strict Ruler who believes in high civic order.

GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.name: Imperial Warlord
GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.description: An imperialistic Ruler who favors stability through subjugation.

GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.name: Fanatic Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.description: A secluded Ruler who values purity of mind and empire.

GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.name: Deceptive Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.description: A cunning Ruler who values power and treachery.

GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.name: Reserved Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.description: An individualistic Ruler who prefers peaceful co-existence.

GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.name: Sinister Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.description: A self-centered Ruler who prefers to deal with the weak.

GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.name: Province-Claiming Pact
GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.description: Both Ruler are allowed to build on each other's claimed Province without triggering Grievance.

GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.name: Wizard's Bond
GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.description:
Both Ruler agree to a wizard's bond to improve Empire Relations and access new Treaty and Diplomatic States.

Effects:The Throne City of each Ruler will be revealed.Rulers can call each other to war.
Leads to: Defensive PactOpen BordersProvince-Claiming PactTeleporter PactFree Trade Agreement

GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.name: Defensive Pact
GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.description:
A Diplomatic State in which the Ruler vow to come to each other's aid in defensive wars.

When war is declared on either Ruler, they will automatically send a Call to War to the other, asking them to aid them in the war. Answering this call to war will give the Ruler additional Grievance to use directly. Rulers may still refuse to accept this call but will break the defensive pact if they do.

Leads to: AllianceShare Vision

GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.name: Open Borders
GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.description: Both Ruler open their borders to each other. This allows Army to move through Province of the opposing Ruler without trespassing.

GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.name: Returning captured heroes.
GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.description:
When captured Hero are returned to their original owner, they will become available for recruitment (for free). Heroes in the Crypt will be returned to the crypt of the original owner instead.

When reaching an Alliance, Ruler will automatically return their captured heroes to the other ruler.

GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.name: Share Vision
GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.description: Both Ruler share their Vision with each other and will reveal explored areas to each other.

GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.name: Teleporter Pact
GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.description: Both Ruler allow each other to teleport to and from their Teleporter.

GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.name: Battlesaint
GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.description:
Battlesaints gain Fervor through particular actions that they spend for powerful support abilities or to empower themselves and smite their enemies.

Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponMagic Staff WeaponMagic Orb WeaponSkirmisher Weapon

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.name: Monuments
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of Province Improvement available to the Architect and built using Wonderstone.
Monuments grant their owner Affinity Incarnate, on higher tiers they grant additional Affinity and economic effects to their owner.

The foundation is built in the city in a manner similar to Special Province Improvement. The Affinity of the Monument is chosen when this is placed down.
The Monument can be improved to further increase its effects:Stage 1 - Foundation
Architect units gain +1 Affinity Incarnate.
+10 City Stability in the city.Stage 2 - Sanctum
Architect units gain +2 Affinity Incarnate.
+20 City Stability in the city.Stage 3 - Zenith
Architect units gain +3 Affinity Incarnate.
Units gain +1 Protection of the monument's Affinity.
The Empire gains +1 of the monument's Affinity.
+20 City Stability in the city.
+10% Food, Production, and Draft in the city.Stage 4 - Apex
Architect units gain +4 Affinity Incarnate.
Units gain +2 Protection of the monument's Affinity.
The Empire gains +2 of the monument's Affinity.
+20 City Stability in the city.
+10% to all income in the city.Counts as a Gold Ancient WonderYour Empire may gain up to 4 Affinity Incarnate from
Monument.

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.name: Monument
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of Province Improvement available to the Architect and built using Wonderstone.
Monuments cannot be hurried in the city screen, and cannot have their cost reduced.

GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.name: Blessed
GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A serene aura can be felt in the surrounding terrain. City annexing this province gain +5 City Stability.

GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.name: Dragon Lord
GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.description:
A mighty Dragon seeking new realms to shape in their vision.
Dragon Lords have access to unique combat Hero Skills.Dragon Lords gain powerful transformation Hero Signature Skills based on empire Affinity.Gain extra Gold through their Dragon Hoard.Dragon Lords are Dragon Governor.Dragon Lords have a 30 Gold Unit Upkeep and cannot equip most Hero Items.

GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.name: Beacon of Light
GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.description: An Army can build a Sanctuary Outpost on a Province. Shielding units from Umbral Malady and allowing annexation of nearby Province.

GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.name: Sanctuary Outpost
GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.description: A type of Outpost that can only be built in a Province in the Umbral Abyss with a Beacon of Light.Friendly Unit inside the Domain of a Sanctuary Outpost are immune to Umbral Malady.City cannot be founded in Sanctuary Outposts.Once built, can be upgraded to annex 2 additional provinces.Grants +10 Gold, +10 Mana, and +10 Knowledge.

GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.name: Eldritch Pact
GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.description: The Dwelling shares its income and Magic Material.The Dwelling shares its vision.The Dwelling allows building on claimed provinces.Contributes 5 to the Rally of the Lieges.Will reinforce in Combat against Marauder and Ruler the Dwelling is at War with.Allows the purchasing of special Spell and other bonuses to benefit from Gloom via Cooperation.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.name: Truce
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.description:
The Umbral Dwelling tolerates you.

Counts as Neutral state.

Umbral Dwellings do not care about Trespassing or Province Claims.

You cannot assign a Whispering Stone to Umbral Dwellings. Instead, making more sacrifices will let you reach an Eldritch Pact.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a Dwelling means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Dwellings will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

When an Umbral Dwelling conquers another City. It will destroy it and create an Umbral Nest Infestation.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.name: Umbral Abyss
GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.description: Units in this layer suffer Umbral Malady.Outpost and City can't be built in this layer. Terraforming Spell can't be used in this layer.

GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.name: Gloom Tear
GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A wound in reality seeping with eldritch power. Makes this province count as having Gloom.

GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.name: Declaration of Debt
GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.description: Utilize Favors to keep another Ruler at bay:A modifier that slowly increases towards 300 will be added to your relations with the Ruler. While the Declaration lasts, the affected player will not have any grudge affecting the relation for any of their Grievance towards you.Maintaining a declaration costs 5 Favors upkeep per Turn, which increases by 5 Favors for each additional declaration.Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncement.

GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.name: Gaining War Spoils
GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are gained through:

Killing Unit belonging to Free City, Dwelling, or Empire.Unit tier I units grant 5 .Unit tier II units grant 10 .Unit tier III units grant 20 .Unit tier IV units grant 40 .Unit tier V units grant 80 .Hero grant 5 per level.
Conquering CityGain 50 + 10 per Population the conquered city had.Pillaging Provinces grants +20 .

GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.name: Favors
GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.description:
A unique resource used by the Federated Reaver subculture.
Favors are used to influence Free Cities, coordinate Vassals, and recruit from Rally of the Lieges.

Favors are gained by defeating Marauder, destroying Infestation, and maintaining Supreme Vassalage with Free City.

GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.name: War Spoils
GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are a unique resource gathered by Imperial Reaver through conquest and battle with Empire, Dwelling, and Free City as well as pillaging. They can be used to:Improve their cities with the repeatable War Trophies structure.Recruit Subdued units after combat.Recruit the Magelock Cannon unit in Imperial Reaver cities..
Gaining War Spoils
Using War Spoils

GLOBAL.TotalWarConcept.name: Total War
GLOBAL.TotalWarConcept.description: No Imperium income penalties from War without War Justification.

GLOBAL.UsingWarspoilsConcept.name: Using War Spoils
GLOBAL.UsingWarspoilsConcept.description: War Spoils can be used to:Improve your cities with the repeatable War Trophies structure.Recruit Subdued units after combat.Recruit the Magelock Cannon unit in Imperial Reaver cities.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingCrystalPactConcept.name: Crystal Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingCrystalPactConcept.description: Will reinforce in Combat against Marauder and Ruler the Dwelling is at War with.Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:Lithorite PrismCrystal FocusCrystallize EssenceCrystal CrashLithorine ShardlancerLithorine GemcasterCompleting Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed Mana in addition to their other rewards.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingEternalPactConcept.name: Eternal Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingEternalPactConcept.description: The Dwelling shares its vision.Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:Lithorite AstrolabeEternal EmbassyLithorine SimulacrumEternal goldseekers pickaxeEternal lithorine orbEternal shatterbladesEternal titans greatbowCompleting Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed Imperium in addition to their other rewards.The Dwelling grants a substantial Knowledge income boon.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingTruceConcept.name: Truce
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingTruceConcept.description:
The Crystal Dwelling tolerates you.

Counts as Neutral state.

Crystal Dwellings do not care about Province Claims.

You cannot assign a Whispering Stone to Crystal Dwellings. Instead, completing quests will let you reach higher diplomatic states and eventually an Eternal Pact.

Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:
Lithorine CoreCrystalrunner mount

GLOBAL.LavaRunesteleConcept.name: Lava Runestele
GLOBAL.LavaRunesteleConcept.description: Every Turn, a Province within 2 Province radius of this structure:Gains Ashlands and Chasm.Loses River, Grassland, Swamp, Snow, Ice, Sand, Cavern Floor, Fungus Fields, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.IceRunesteleConcept.name: Ice Runestele
GLOBAL.IceRunesteleConcept.description: Every Turn, a Province within 2 Province radius of this structure:Gains Snow and Ice.Loses Chasm, Grassland, Swamp, River, Ashlands, Sand, Cavern Floor, Fungus Fields, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.RockRunesteleConcept.name: Rock Runestele
GLOBAL.RockRunesteleConcept.description: Every Turn, a Province within 2 Province radius of this structure:Gains Mountain if on the Surface or Stalagmites if in the Underground.

GLOBAL.StormRunesteleConcept.name: Storm Runestele
GLOBAL.StormRunesteleConcept.description: Every Turn, a Surface Province within 2 Province radius of this structure:Gains a River.Loses Ashlands, Chasm, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a Dwelling means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Dwellings will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.name: Shop Structure
GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.description:
Shops are Location that can appear randomly in your domain as you play. In return for Gold or Mana, they can give you access to many unique bonuses—such as new mounts and skills for your heroes, or information on the whereabouts of your foes.

You can use any shop within your domain immediately, if the shop is outside your domain you will need to move an Army onto it to unlock it. Once unlocked, you can access the shop without your army being present.

You may choose to attack the shop if you wish—you will gain valuable rewards if you win, but don't expect your custom to be welcome if you do not!

GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.name: Landmark
GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.description:
Landmarks are a type of location the size of an entire region. Landmarks themselves cannot be annexed or claimed. Instead, landmarks grant effects to all adjacent Province.

If a City has a certain amount of provinces in their domain adjacent to one Landmark, they gain an additional bonus effect depending on the type of landmark.

Landmarks count as Handcrafted Region, meaning they can be disabled with the Untouched Realm Trait.

GLOBAL.FireGiantKingConcept.name: Fire Giant King
GLOBAL.FireGiantKingConcept.description:
A searing Giant who cleaves realms by molding lava.
Capital city starts with Wizard Tower: Item Forge.Has the Summon Lava Runestele spell.Can build Farm on Ashlands.Provinces with Lava or Lava Chasms provide +2 Production and don't apply the extra City Stability penalty normally found in these.Giant Kings are Giant King Governor.Giant Kings have a 5 Mana Unit Upkeep and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.FrostGiantKingConcept.name: Frost Giant King
GLOBAL.FrostGiantKingConcept.description:
An icy Giant who freezes realms by shaping glaciers.
Capital city starts with Wizard Tower: Item Forge.Has the Summon Ice Runestele spell.Can build Farm on Snow.Provinces with Snow or Ice provide +2 Mana.Giant Kings are Giant King Governor.Giant Kings have a 5 Mana Unit Upkeep and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.StoneGiantKingConcept.name: Rock Giant King
GLOBAL.StoneGiantKingConcept.description:
An adamant Giant who sculpts realms by raising mountains.
Capital city starts with Wizard Tower: Item Forge.Has the Summon Rock Runestele spell.Provinces with Mountains or Stalagmites provide +2 Production.Giant Kings are Giant King Governor.Giant Kings have a 5 Mana Unit Upkeep and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.StormGiantKingConcept.name: Storm Giant King
GLOBAL.StormGiantKingConcept.description:
A thunderous Giant who levels realms by flattening peaks.
Capital city starts with Wizard Tower: Item Forge.Has the Summon Storm Runestele spell.Provinces with Rivers or Water provide +2 Food and +1 Mana.Giant Kings are Giant King Governor.Giant Kings have a 5 Mana Unit Upkeep and cannot equip Mount items.

GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.name: Favored Terrain
GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.description: The Primal culture gains various bonuses from its favored terrain:Their Primal Animal gains Frenzy in their favored terrain.Extra income is earned from provinces in favored terrain.The Spirit Temple structure can alter provinces into favored terrain.

GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.name: Cataclysm Victory
GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Cataclysm Victory, explore the Echoes of the Fracturing searching for the Artifact of the Unmakers within Fated Regions.

Acquire 3 Artifact to claim victory.

GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.name: Loot
GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.description:
Can be picked up by any unit with the Scavenger property by moving onto this hex.
On pickup, the unit:Gains Looted Power.Heals for +15 Hit Point.

GLOBAL.NomadConcept.name: Nomad
GLOBAL.NomadConcept.description: Mobile units that focus on maneuvering and flanking.Nomad Cities are able to pack up into a Nomad City Barge and relocate.Nodes in domain of their Cities are Overharvested over time, exhausting the Nodes to gain Essence in that city.Nomad Cities require 50% more Food to gain Population.

GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.name: Aggressive Expansion
GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.description:
Aggressive Expansion rewards Province Annexation of provinces belonging to other factions.

Annexing a hostile province to a city grants a one time reward of Production, Draft, and Gold.

These rewards scale with the population of the city the province was taken from.

GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.name: Essence
GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.description:
Essences are magical objects tied to a city, granting income and other bonuses. They are obtained by Overharvesting Resource Node with a Nomad City.
The type of income an essence gives depends on the node they come from.Essences from Magic Material grant that material to the city's owner.If a city carrying Magic Material essences is razed, those Magic Material will appear as nodes nearby.
Nomads of the Scavenger tradition also gain unique Essences with Wonder Scavenging.

GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.name: Overharvesting
GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.description:
Nomad City Overharvest Resource Node in their Domain. This process takes several turns but may be accelerated using Imperium proportionate to the time remaining on that particular Node.

Once Overharvested:The City gains an Essence corresponding to that Node.The Resource Node is destroyed, becoming a Ruined Node.

GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.name: Nomad City Barge
GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.description:
Nomad City may pack up into a City Barge, a unit that can move around on the World Map.

This unit:Can Unpack into a Nomad City, able to immediately claim Province as its Population allows.Can place any Special Province Improvement it had before being packed up for free.Does not participate in Combat and is defeated immediately if not defended by other friendly units.Combat against this unit will take place on the Siege city defense map with all City Defense structures present.
If this unit is defeated in combat, it may be captured by the victor or immediately Razed.

GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.name: Wonder Scavenging
GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.description:
When an Ancient Wonder is annexed to a City belonging to Nomad Scavengers, it will be Overharvested, granting the city a unique Essence.

Overharvesting Ancient Wonders:Does not destroy the Ancient Wonder.Can only be done once per Ancient Wonder.
The type of Essence gained is based on the Improvement type and Tier of the Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.name: Roaming City Income
GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.description: Roaming City Income is the amount of Resource a Nomad City Barge generates each Turn while packed up.

GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.name: Sandstorm
GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:Have a base 60% chance of becoming Blind for 1 Turn.Become Slowed for 1 Turn.Units with Sand Walk are immune to this effect.

GLOBAL.BackfireConcept.name: Spell Backfiring
GLOBAL.BackfireConcept.description:
Spell may have a chance of backfiring.

When a spell can backfire, the chance is displayed in the casting menu. Upon casting the spell, you will be informed if the spell backfired or not. When a spell does not backfire, the spell is resolved as normal and nothing else happens.

When a spell backfires, its original effects are still resolved, but additional effects are added to the spell. These additional effects are random and usually affect the targets of the original spell.

For example: When a Healing Spell backfires, it could have the additional effect of teleporting the unit that was healed up to 3 hexes away from its location.

GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.name: Backfire Tailwind
GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.description: When a healing or buffing spell Backfires for this player, it always triggers a positive effect.When a damaging or debuffing spell Backfires for this player, it always triggers a negative effect for the enemy.

GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.name: Shrouded Isle
GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.description: A shrouded isle is a handcrafted region which:Is only accessible through a portal on Surface or Underground.These portals must be uncovered through a quest.These portals are guarded by inhabitants.Contains a Shrouded Arcanum. Which unlocks a Secret Spell.Contains other valuable Location in the region which are not guarded by Marauder Army.

GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.name: Breached Isle
GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.description: A breached isle is a handcrafted region which:Is only accessible through a portal on Surface or Underground.These portals are accessible at the start and are not guarded.Contains a Breached Arcanum and various other valuable Location

GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.name: Blood Drain
GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.description: The blood draining abilities of a Vampire: Draining Bite and Siphon Blood.

GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.name: Crimson Court Magistrate
GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.description: Gain 50 Mana on successfully Pillaging a Province Improvement.Gain 50 Mana on successfully Razing a conquered City per Population and Province Improvement that hasn't been Pillaged.Gain 30 Mana on successfully Migrating a conquered City per Population. But the City loses additional Population afterward.Vassal grant 10 Mana income per Population.

GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.name: Sunless
GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.description:
A Province Feature

The absence of sunlight has spread thorny and dark flora dotted with crimson roses.
City annexing this Province suffer -5 City Stability.Unit regenerate -5 Hit Point per Turn in the World Map.Unit receive 25% less Temporary Hit Point when healed in Combat.Units and Cities that have Heartless or are of an empire led by a Elder Vampire are immune to these effects.

GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.name: Elder Vampire
GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.description:
A deathless Vampire who drains the life from enemies under cover of night.
An Undead unit with an aversion to light.Has access to Vampire Castle: Foundation which replaces the Wizard Tower: Foundation and grants the use of Thrall to cast powerful ritual Spell.Drains 20% of the combat Experience earned by Turned Vampire heroes.Faction is immune to Sunless terrain's penalties to City Stability and Morale.Elder Vampires are Elder Vampire Governor.Elder Vampires have a 5 Gold Unit Upkeep

GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.name: Devotion
GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.description:
Reflects how devoted to its oath your empire is based on its actions. Devotion influences:The strength of the Harmonize, Nobility and Warrior's Soul culture unit abilities. City Stability in your cities.
Levels of Devotion:120 to 130: Paragon70 to 119: Devotee20 to 69: Adherent0 to 19: Neutral-1 to -40: {GLOBAL.Devotion-1Concept.Hyperlink}

GLOBAL.MistConcept.name: Mist
GLOBAL.MistConcept.description: Units that end their turn on this hex gain Clinging Mist.

GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.name: Cataclysm
GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.description:
A Cataclysm can trigger due to the Devouring Winds. When it triggers:
All provinces that were marked are struck:If a structure is present in the center of the province, it is destroyed or Pillaged.A Fleeting Fractured Infestation is placed in the center of the province if able.The province is no longer marked.All Spell permanently gain +10% chance of Backfiring.All Empire gain a Grievance against the Empire that triggered the Cataclysm.The Cataclysm Meter is reset and its level increases by 1.

GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.name: Fortification Damage
GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.description:
Fortification Damage represents the speed at which a Siege progresses to breach the defenses of a City

Fortification Damage is subtracted from Fortification Health of the City during a Siege until it is reduced to 0.

Fortification Damage in a Siege comes from:A base value of 10Siege Project the besieger is undertaking.Besieging Unit with Siege Breaker that are adjacent to the City.

GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.name: Fortification Health
GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.description:
Fortification Health represents how long the duration of a Siege will be on a City. The greater the Fortification Health, the longer the Siege will take.

During a Siege, the besieger will try and reduce the City's Fortification Health to 0 by dealing Fortification Damage. Fortification Health cannot increase during a Siege.

City Defense Structure are the primary source of Fortification Health.

A City with Fortification Health still requires any Wall structure to be present before a siege is required.

GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.name: Alignment Agenda
GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.description:
The High Culture has an Alignment Agenda, which grants bonuses for the following alignment levels:
Slightly Good: +10 Food and Production income in all City. Very Good: +20 Food and Production income in all City. Pure Good: +30 Food and Production income in all City. Slightly Evil: +10 Gold and Mana income in all City. Very Evil: +20 Gold and Mana income in all City. Pure Evil: +30 Gold and Mana income in all City.

GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.name: Alignment
GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.description:
Determines how Free City and other Empire see you. Affected by Ruler traits and various actions.

Affects relations with Free City and Empire with Neutral or better Alignment. In addition a Good Alignment (or better) will increase the chance of positive random events occurring, while an Evil Alignment (or worse) will make negative random events more likely.

High Culture has an Alignment Agenda.

Empire Relations for each Alignment level: {PureGoodMinValue} to {PureGoodMaxValue}: Pure Good: {PureGoodRelationValue} {VeryGoodMinValue} to {VeryGoodMaxValue}: Very Good: {VeryGoodRelationValue} {GoodMinValue} to {GoodMaxValue}: Good: {GoodRelationValue} {NeutralMaxValue} to {NeutralMinValue}: Neutral: No effects{EvilMaxValue} to {EvilMinValue}: Evil: {EvilRelationValue} {VeryEvilMaxValue} to {VeryEvilMinValue}: Very Evil: {VeryEvilRelationValue} {PureEvilMaxValue} to {PureEvilMinValue}: Pure Evil: {PureEvilRelationValue}

GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.name: Competitor
GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.description:
Competitors are Ruler that have at least negotiated a Pact of Cooperation with a Free City and are actively negotiating with that City.

Competing Rulers will receive a Grievance against a Ruler that vassalizes their desired city.

GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.name: Dwellings
GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.description:
Dwellings are independent City that usually have unique ways to influence and offer unique benefits.

Like Free City they:Have a Free City Lord.Have diplomatic standings with you that can be improved.Do not belong to an Empire.
Dwellings are not affected by Realm Traits or Spell that affect Free Cities.

GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.name: Empire Relations
GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.description:
Represents the degree to which two Empire are on good terms with one another.

Good Empire Relations are required to negotiate a Wizard's Bond and Treaty. Eventually good relations can lead to an Alliance.

Bad Empire Relations increase the chance of War being declared.

Empire Relations can be improved by:High AlignmentPronouncementGiftsTrades

GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.name: Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.description:
Free Cities are City that do not belong to an Empire. They have a Free City Lord with whom it is possible to negotiate.

With a higher Diplomatic State, a Free City offers:Trading. Recruitment Point for the Rally of the Lieges.Shared Income.
When an Empire reaches the highest Diplomatic State with a Free City, the city may become part of that empire through a Pact of Integration. Alternatively War may be declared to acquire the Free City through conquest.

GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.name: Free City Lord
GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.description:
A Free City Lord or Lady is the designated ruler of a Free City. They represent their Free City in all diplomatic interactions with an Empire and fight for their city as Hero on the World Map.

When the Free City Lord dies (and their Free City has not been conquered or integrated) they will be replaced by their heir, who will become the new Free City Lord after 3 Turn. The free city will not be able to cast Combat Spell until this has happened.

GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.name: Free City Diplomatic State
GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.description:
The diplomatic state with a Free City is the formal expression of their Allegiance. A newly met Free City will be on neutral terms with an Empire (in some cases War is declared instantly). By sending their Free City Lord a Whispering Stone, the Allegiance of the Free City with that Empire will improve over time.

Higher Allegiance leads to better diplomatic states with more valuable benefits. This negotiation process is divided into the Negotiation Phase and the Vassalage Phase, which eventually leads to the Pact of Integration.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.name: Free City relations
GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.description: Relations with a Free City represent their opinion of a Ruler. The relation value can affect the amount of Allegiance gained during Negotiation and with very low relations the free city may also declare War when on the Neutral diplomatic state.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.name: Free City Trade
GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.description:
Free City may be asked to focus on a particular resource by Ruler that share at least a Pact of Cooperation with the City.

They may also provide any Magic Material located in the domain of the city in exchange for payment.

A Free City will only agree to one active trade at a time, after the trade has expired a new trade can be made.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.name: War with a Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a Free City means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Free Cities will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.description: There are two different types of negotiations:Negotiation between Ruler.Negotiation between Rulers and Free City.

GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.name: Negotiation with Free City
GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.description:
Negotiations increase the Allegiance of a Free City leading to better Diplomatic State with an Empire.

Negotiations happen automatically when a Whispering Stone is assigned or the city is vassalized.

GLOBAL.TradeConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.TradeConcept.description: Negotiations allow Rulers to exchange strategic resources, locations and contact information among other things, but it also allows them to manage their relations and establish new Treaty and diplomatic states.

GLOBAL.WarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.WarConcept.description:
A state of War with an Empire or Free City means their Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

Wars end through defeat on either side or peacefully when:Two Empires negotiate a Truce.By negotiating Peace with a Free City.
Defeat occurs when one side loses its Throne City and Ruler.

GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.name: Research
GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.description: Research is where Knowledge is spent to unlock items from Tome.

GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.name: Enchantments and Single Shot Attacks
GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.description:
Damage and chance-based effects from Unit Enchantment and Hero Skills have increased potency on Single Shot attacks, like Flyby Melee Charge and Magic Blast.

Usually flat damage values are doubled, and the chances of Negative Status Effect are increased by 30%

GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.name: Astral Boon
GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the Astral forces strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.name: Chaos Boon
GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Chaos strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.name: Materium Boon
GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Materium strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.name: Nature Boon
GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Nature strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.name: Order Boon
GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Order strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your cities.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.name: Shadow Boon
GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Shadow strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Shadow Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.name: Affinity Check
GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.description:
When the empire of a player has reached a high enough Affinity score, this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions the player Ruler or one of their heroes attempts to channel the respective Affinity to perform a challenging action.

Each Affinity check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the empire Affinity is lower than X.50% base chance to succeed when the empire Affinity is exactly X.This chance increases by 10% for every Empire Affinity Point above X.

GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.name: Astral Crisis
GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the Astral forces weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.name: Chaos Crisis
GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Chaos weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.name: Materium Crisis
GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Materium weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.name: Nature Crisis
GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Nature weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.name: Order Crisis
GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Order weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.name: Battle Quest
GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.description: Battle Quests ask you to defeat an Army of Marauder Unit on the World Map. They may only be resolved through Combat and will fail when another non-ally Player defeats the quest army.

GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.name: Befriend City Quest
GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.description: Befriend City Quests ask you to reach a higher diplomatic state with a Free City. This can be achieved by giving that Free City a Whispering Stone and improving their Allegiance with you over time. If the Free City becomes vassalized or conquered by another Player, the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.name: Build Improvement Quest
GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.description: Build Improvement Quests ask you to construct a number of Province Improvement of a certain type. You can build a Province Improvement whenever one of your City grows new Population. When you dismantle a Province Improvement of the matching type this will subtract progress from the quest.

GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.name: Conquer City Quest
GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.description: Conquer City quests ask you to conquer a Free City. This requires you to declare war on that Free City and may involve a Siege if there are any City Defense Structure. If the Free City becomes conquered by another Player (even an ally) the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.name: Destroy Infestation Quest
GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.description: Destroy Infestation quests ask you to destroy an Infestation on the World Map. Beware of the roaming Army inside the Infestation's Domain! If the Infestation is destroyed by another non-ally Player the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.name: Encounter Quest
GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.description: Encounter Quests ask you to deal with an Army of Marauder Unit on the World Map. When engaging the quest army, there will be narrative choices that may alter Combat in your favor or even completely avoid it for a price.

GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.name: Magic Material Quest
GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.description: Magic Material Quests ask you to obtain a Magic Material. This can be either achieved by annexing a Province with a Magic Material Node in its Domain or by acquiring the Magic Material through a trade with a Free City or Player.

GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.name: Primal Check
GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.description:
When a monster ruler has reached a high enough Level, this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions, the player ruler attempts to channel their primal powers to perform a challenging action.

Each Primal Check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the Ruler Level is lower than X.50% base chance of success when the Ruler Level is exactly X.This chance increases by +10% for every Ruler Level above X.

GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.name: Expansion Victory
GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve an Expansion Victory, an Empire needs to control enough provinces to unlock the Beacon of Unity.
