These are weapon pairs, such as a crossbow and dagger, that allow a hero to make both melee and ranged attacks.

Usable by:Hero Class: RangerHero Class: DefenderHero Class: WarriorHero Class: Death KnightHero Class: Spellblade

GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept.name: Great Weapon
GLOBAL.GreatWeaponConcept.description:
These are larger melee weapons such as great swords and great axes. They grant the hero a Charge attack.

Usable by:Hero Class: WarriorHero Class: Death KnightHero Class: Spellblade

GLOBAL.KeeperConcept.name: Keeper
GLOBAL.KeeperConcept.description:
The Race Keeper is the Ruler whose Empire has the biggest presence of a race, through owned City and Vassal. You are always the Keeper of the race you start with.

To become the Keeper of a Race you need to have Race population threshold% of the race's Population in your Empire. If the race already has a Race Keeper you need Race population overtake threshold Population more than them to take it from them.

To become the Keeper of another player's starting race the player would have to be defeated first.

The Race Keeper is the only Ruler who can apply Major Race Transformation and Minor Race Transformation.

GLOBAL.LavaConcept.name: Lava
GLOBAL.LavaConcept.description:
Lava is a type of terrain that can appear both on the surface and underground. When a City annexes a Province with lava, they suffer a City Stability penalty. This penalty can be avoided by having either the Underground or Desolate Adaptation.

If the center of a province is in lava, then you will be able to build a Mine or Conduit Province Improvement.

Units that can traverse lava need to have one of the following:FlyingFloatingLava Walk

GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept.name: Major Race Transformation
GLOBAL.MajorRaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful Spell that transforms the essence of an entire race, granting powerful bonuses to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's Keeper.A race can have only one Major Race Transformation at a time.

GLOBAL.MigratingConcept.name: Migrating
GLOBAL.MigratingConcept.description: Migrating a City makes it part of your Empire under your direct control, replacing its original race and culture with yours.

GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept.name: Minor Race Transformation
GLOBAL.MinorRaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful Spell that transforms the essence of an entire Race, granting a bonus to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's Keeper.A race can have a number of Minor Race Transformations at once.

GLOBAL.NatureConcept.name: Nature Affinity
GLOBAL.NatureConcept.description:
Nature Affinity governs the energies of life, promoting growth and revitalization. It is associated with farming, druidism and control over the living world.

Nature Affinity is opposed by Shadow Affinity. Empire or Free City with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept.name: Status Effects Countering
GLOBAL.OpposingStatusEffectsConcept.description:
Sometimes a status effect counters another. This means:
You can remove a status effect by applying the status effect that counters it.When a status effect counters another, it is not applied itself.

GLOBAL.OrderConcept.name: Order Affinity
GLOBAL.OrderConcept.description:
Order Affinity is the power that brings structure to the Cosmos and to the lives of mortals. Associated with light, faith, justice, and the government of empires.

Order Affinity is opposed by Chaos Affinity. Empire or Free City with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.AscendedTransformationConcept.name: Ascended Transformation
GLOBAL.AscendedTransformationConcept.description: Ascended transformations are Race Transformation that a Ruler had when they ascended to the Pantheon. The ascended transformations only apply to the Ruler (not their race) when they next appear on a realm.

GLOBAL.AscendedConcept.name: Ascended
GLOBAL.AscendedConcept.description:
An ascended Ruler has proven worthy to join the Pantheon and can be selected to appear as either a recruitable Hero or as Ruler.

Ascended Rulers may receive an Ascension Trait and can keep Race Transformation for when they next appear on a realm.

GLOBAL.AscensionTraitConcept.name: Ascension Trait
GLOBAL.AscensionTraitConcept.description: An ascension trait is received by a Ruler upon conquering a realm. A Ruler can only have one ascension trait and can choose a trait based on the Tome they have unlocked on the realm.

GLOBAL.PillagingConcept.name: Pillaging
GLOBAL.PillagingConcept.description:
Some locations such as Province Improvement cannot be Razed but can be pillaged instead, granting Resource rewards.
When a province improvement is pillaged it is turned into Ruins.Ruins can be rebuilt at the cost of Gold.Ruins from enemy City can be Annexed to your own.

GLOBAL.PopulationConcept.name: Population
GLOBAL.PopulationConcept.description:
Population represents the size of a City. It allows the City to build new Province Improvement and expand its Domain.

Population increases with Food income and requires Population Upkeep.

GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept.name: Population Upkeep
GLOBAL.PopulationUpkeepConcept.description:
Each Population in a City costs 3 Food and 5 City Stability.

Negative Food income can lead to Starvation!

GLOBAL.PrisonConcept.name: Prison
GLOBAL.PrisonConcept.description:
When you defeat an enemy Hero in combat, they have a chance of going to your prison or your Crypt.

Heroes in your prison can be granted their freedom to get their equipment and to improve relations with the Free City or Ruler they belong to.

Certain Heroes can never go to the Prison:Free City Lord cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.Marauder Heroes cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.Ruler can never be captured, and will go to the Void instead.

GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.name: Production Queue
GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.description:
Production Queues in City allow for the construction of City Structure and recruitment of Unit.

Production and Draft resources are used up when building the first item in the Production Queue. Items in the queue can be reprioritized after being added.

GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.name: Race Transformation
GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful Spell that transforms the essence of an entire race, granting a bonus to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's Keeper.A race can have any number of Minor Race Transformations at once.A race can have only one Major Race Transformation at a time.

GLOBAL.RazingConcept.name: Razing
GLOBAL.RazingConcept.description:
Army can remove an empire's Domain from a province by razing the Outpost or City at its center. Province Improvement cannot be razed, but can be Pillaged instead.

Razing cities leaves behind ruins which can be rebuilt at the cost of Imperium.

GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.name: Rally of the Lieges
GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.description:
This is where you can draft Unit into your empire or to help defend Vassal Cities using Recruitment Point.

The pool of available units consists primarily of units made available to you by loyal City and annexed Ancient Wonder. The number of units available depends on how many Recruitment Points you have available. The units made available by cities will be randomly selected based on the units that city can produce, focusing on higher tier units.

Rallies will be held every 15 Turn and only at that point will the pool of units and the number of points you can spend refresh. You can, however, use a boost to halve the amount of remaining turns once per Rally.

GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.name: Ritual of Alacrity
GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.description:
Players can activate the Ritual of Alacrity on any owned Barbarian Outpost and City.

When activated, friendly Unit on the center of the Outpost or City will restore 50% Hit Point, 100% Move Point, and removes Exhausted from Forced March.

GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.name: Ruler in the Void
GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.description: When a Ruler perishes during battle or otherwise, they will be cast into the Astral Void. If that Ruler still holds their Throne City, they will materialize there in 3 Turn. If that Ruler has lost their Throne City, their Empire is defeated. While in the Void, the Ruler's empire is in chaos and subject to the following penalties:-20 City Stability in each city.Governor bonuses are not applied.Research is paused.No Spell can be cast.Active Magic Victory spells are canceled and their progress reset.

GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.name: Scout Prospecting
GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.description:
When Industrious Scout Unit stand within a friendly or neutral Province that contains a Cliff, Mountain or Stalagmite, the player that owns the Scout Unit can prospect the Province for Production or Gold rewards.

Each Province can only be prospected once.

GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.name: Sensing Range
GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.description: Sensing Range is the number of hexes within which the presence of Unit can be detected in the Fog of War.

GLOBAL.ShadowConcept.name: Shadow Affinity
GLOBAL.ShadowConcept.description:
Shadow Affinity relates to the realm of death, decay and ice, as well as deception and instilling and exploiting weakness.

Shadow Affinity is opposed by Nature Affinity. Empire or Free City with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.name: Siege
GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.description:
If a City has a Wall Structure and you wish to conquer it, you first need to besiege it and breach its defenses.

A Siege can be initiated by attacking any of the 7 City hexes with at least 1 Army led by a Hero which must remain adjacent to the city until the siege is completed or else the Siege is lifted.

While sieging the City's Fortification Health is lowered by the besieger's Fortification Damage.

Siege Project can be used to speed up the siege by dealing more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Once Fortification Health reaches 0, the attacker can move into the City for a decisive battle.

GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.name: Siege Project
GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.description:
Siege Projects can be used during a Siege to speed up the siege by adding more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Siege Projects can only be added and removed in the Turn the Siege was initiated.

You can only have as many siege projects added as you can have slots. More slots can be gained through Empire Skill.

GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.name: Special Province Improvement
GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.description:
Special Province Improvement are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement.

Effects can include:Improved income based on adjacent Province.Army effects in and around the Special Province Improvement.Army spawn points.Army visit bonuses.
Special Province Improvements are unlocked with Tome and cultures.

GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.name: Spell Slots
GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.description:
Spell slots are used to prepare spells ready for casting. Once your spell slots are full you will need to cast or cancel a prepared spell before you can start preparing any new spells.

You can gain another spell slot by building the Wizard Tower: Channeling Chamber in your Throne City.

GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.name: Spell Victory
GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.description: Casting this spell has a global effect and is required to reach Magic Victory.This spell requires time to channel once cast.

GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.name: Starvation
GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.description:
When Population Upkeep is higher than Food income, the city's Population will starve.

Starvation leads to Population dying and a Province Improvement leaving the city every 3 << Turn>>

GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.name: World Map
GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.description: The World Map is where City are built, Army are moved, and Location are explored.

GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.name: World Map Summon Spell
GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.description: Summons a Unit with Magic Origin.Can be cast on any hex adjacent to your heroes, ruler, or one of your cities.Units with Land Movement cannot be summoned onto water hexes.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.name: Structure Queue
GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.description: The Structure Queue is where City Structure are built by spending Gold and Production.

GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.name: Sustained City Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.description: Can affect the targeted city and its domain.The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.name: Sustained World Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.description: The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.name: Swallowed
GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unit is removed from combat.</bullet><bullet>If another unit is swallowed, the previous swallowed unit dies.</bullet><bullet>If the unit that ate the unit is killed, the last unit swallowed is released.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CombatConcept.name: Combat
GLOBAL.CombatConcept.description:
Combat occurs when an Army encounters an enemy Army, or while exploring Ancient Wonder.

Combat occurs on a separate map and is Turn-based.

With the Reinforcement Rule, up to 6 armies can participate in the battle.

The battle is won by the last combatant that has Unit left.

GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.name: Terraforming Spell
GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.description: Terraforms one or more Province.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.name: Throne City
GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.description: Your Throne City is the capital of your Empire. Losing it and your Ruler simultaneously ends your Empire.

GLOBAL.TomeConcept.name: Tome
GLOBAL.TomeConcept.description:
A Tome is a collection of Spell, Unit and other skills that you can Research. Tomes also have initial bonuses you get for free.

Tier 1 tomes are always available, to unlock higher tier tomes:Research 2 Tomes of any tier.Tier 3 tomes require you to have 3 points of a single Affinity.Tier 4 tomes require you to have 6 points of a single Affinity.Tier 5 Tomes require you to have 8 points of a single Affinity.Tomes can contain:SpellUnitSpecial Province ImprovementCity StructureSiege Project

GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.name: Tome Passive
GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.description: A passive bonus that is immediately active once the tome has been chosen.

GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.name: Tooltip
GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.description: Well done! Use this useful feature to learn about concepts and systems as you go. You can string together tooltips endlessly, however older ones will close as you go deeper.

GLOBAL.TurnConcept.name: Turn
GLOBAL.TurnConcept.description:
The unit of time in which Player carry out all of their actions.

On the World Map, turns take the form of either Classic Turn or Simultaneous Turn.

Turns during Combat are taken one Player after another.

GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.name: Underground
GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.description: The layer of the World Map that can be accessed with Underground Passages.

GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.name: Uninhabited Province
GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.description: An uninhabited province is a province that isn't part of anyone's Domain and doesn't contain an Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.UnitConcept.name: Unit
GLOBAL.UnitConcept.description:
Units are the forces that make up your Army.

Units can explore the World Map and engage in Combat.

Can be recruited in City or summoned using Spell.

Units require Gold or Mana upkeep each Turn.

GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Enchantment Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.description: Each Unit Enchantment has its own upkeep cost in Gold and Mana which is added to the Unit Upkeep of each Unit that is using it.

GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.description:
Each Turn on the World Map, you must pay Gold and Mana to maintain your Unit. High tier units also require Imperium. If you cannot afford this, your units will lose Morale!

A unit's upkeep depends on: Unit tier Unit EnchantmentSome Empire Skills and Hero Skills can reduce the Gold and Mana upkeep, but never below 50% of its value.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.name: Viability
GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.description:
Viability describes how likely it is for a Ruler to complete the Bounty objective.
Other Rulers may not be at war with you if they want to accept the bounty. They must also have met the target Ruler or Free City, and AI controlled Rulers must be at war with the target.

For AI controlled Rulers, their army power and proximity to the target are also taken into account, as well as how strongly the target is defended. The viability also influences the chances of AI controlled Rulers accepting the bounty.

GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.name: Vision Range
GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.description: Vision Range is the number of hexes that remove Fog of War.

GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.name: World Map Spell
GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.description:
These are Spell that are cast on the World Map, using World Map Casting Point.

Types of World Map Spells are: City Spell Enemy Army Spell Friendly Army Spell Major Race Transformation Minor Race Transformation Spell Victory Summon Spell Sustained City Spell Sustained World Spell Terraforming Spell Unit Enchantment World Spell

GLOBAL.WorldSpellConcept.name: World Spell
GLOBAL.WorldSpellConcept.description: Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.name: Reward: Race Relation
GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.description: This quest hands out race relation as a guaranteed reward. This means all owned City of that race will receive a temporary City Stability bonus, and all met Free City receive a Relations bonus.

GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.name: Reward: Unknown Bonus
GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.description: Unknown rewards can be earned after completion.

GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.name: Reward: Mystery Bonus
GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.description: Bonus rewards can be earned through different story event choices after completion.

GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.name: Outnumbered
GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.description: A unit is outnumbered if the number of units on the opposing side is greater than the number of units on their own side.

GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.name: Unknown Trait
GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.description: Unknown traits are hidden when the game begins, and are slowly revealed as it progresses.

GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.name: Cavern Floor
GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Rough, nearly barren rock. A Hut can be built here.
Underground-adapted factions can build a Farm here instead.

GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.name: Diggable Earth
GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Can be Excavated one Province at a time by Unit once the Excavation Empire Skill is acquired.

GLOBAL.SwampConcept.name: Swamp
GLOBAL.SwampConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Swampy marshlands. A Farm can be built here, but factions without Swamp Adaptation will suffer -2 Food.

GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.name: Underground Water
GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

A province of water in the underground. A water Farm can be built here.

GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.name: Uninhabitable
GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

This province is uninhabitable. You cannot build an Outpost here, nor can you annex this Province to a City.

GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.name: Marauder
GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.description: Marauders are hostile Army threatening the World Map that are not affiliated with a Free City or Empire.

GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.name: Mangrove Forest
GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

A forest with its roots submerged in water. A water Forester can be built here.

GLOBAL.VoidConcept.name: Void
GLOBAL.VoidConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A void is present in the province which blocks all movement and cannot be built upon.

GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.name: Terraforming
GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.description:
Terraforming effects can change the appearance and Province Feature in a Province. Terraforming can change what Province Improvement can be built in a Province, but does not destroy or change already built Province Improvements.

When terraforming originates from a source, such as a City or Province Improvement, then removing the source will revert the terraforming effects. When there is no source that can be removed, terraforming is permanent until overwritten by a new terraforming effect.

World Map Spell can apply terraforming effects. When you cancel a sustained effect such as a Sustained World Spell, its terraforming changes will not be reverted.

Certain provinces or features, such as Lava, Water, and Uninhabitable provinces, cannot normally be terraformed.

GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept.name: Champion
GLOBAL.MortalChampionConcept.description:
A Ruler risen from the ranks of their people.
Mortal Champions have access to unique army leadership hero skills.Mortal Champion Rulers gain +20% Experience.Start with +100 Relation with Free Cities.Mortal Champion Rulers start with the Spur to Action ability in Combat.Mortal Champions are Champion Governor.

GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept.name: Wizard King
GLOBAL.WizardKingConcept.description:
A powerful Wizard seeking dominion over a new realm.
Wizard Kings have access to unique Combat Spell enhancing hero skills.All Conduit grant +5 Mana.Start with +10 Combat Casting Point and +10 World Map Casting Point.Wizard Kings start with the Channeling Ritual ability in Combat.Wizard Kings are Wizard Governor.

GLOBAL.CreepingConcept.name: Creeping
GLOBAL.CreepingConcept.description: At the end of the Turn, this obstacle replicates itself to an adjacent hex once.

GLOBAL.DrainingConcept.name: Draining
GLOBAL.DrainingConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn in this position suffer Disrupted for 1 Turn. If that unit has Magic Origin it also suffers Decaying for 3 Turn

GLOBAL.AIPersonalityConcept.name: AI Personality
GLOBAL.AIPersonalityConcept.description:
The AI personality is an optional setting which determines the personality of a Ruler when you encounter them as an AI controlled Ruler in different sessions. This setting does not affect your empire when you are playing as this Ruler.

The personality affects the choices and behavior of AI Rulers in terms of Diplomacy, Research, Economy, and Military. When using the Default option, the system will pick a personality based on the starting Affinity and Alignment of your custom Ruler when it is AI controlled.

GLOBAL.AerelazaliarLoreConcept.name: Aerelazaliar
GLOBAL.AerelazaliarLoreConcept.description:
Having hatched only ten cosmic cycles ago, Aerelazaliar would be considered "young" among his Dragonkin. Perhaps it is his youth that drives his curiosity and kindness towards those his kin would deem inferior. He pays their comments no mind, for Aerelazaliar's gaze drifts beyond his nature of creation and destruction and he dares to question "why".

The Starbred Salamanders were created in Aerelazaliar's own image. It is rare for a Dragon to create their own people, and many wonder what the consequences of Aerelazaliar's "vain splurge in divinity" will be. His people, however, are forever grateful for their draconic father's care.

GLOBAL.AfflictingMiasmaHazard.name: Afflicting Miasma
GLOBAL.AfflictingMiasmaHazard.description:
Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with Weakened.
Units on this hex have Afflicted.

GLOBAL.AlfredElderstoneLoreConcept.name: Alfred Elderstone
GLOBAL.AlfredElderstoneLoreConcept.description:
When he was a young prince, Alfred saw the deaths of his parents at the hands of an invading Wizard. In order to protect his people, he united the splintered factions of Athla under one banner and started the search for a new home.

After the return of the Wizard Kings, the many human factions of Athla were unable to rise against the invasion. It took a great hero—a young prince who knew tremendous loss, to unite them under the banner of the Destined Humans.

GLOBAL.AngelizeConcept.name: Angelic Transformation
GLOBAL.AngelizeConcept.description: Turns the target race into angelic beings, granting them:The Celestial unit type.Flying Movement, which increases mobility.Faithful, which reduces Unit Upkeep.Decreased number of units in formation.

GLOBAL.AnonLoreConcept.name: Anon
GLOBAL.AnonLoreConcept.description:
A simple old man in appearance, Anon represents Archon virtues like few others. As a Pacifist, Scholar, and Oracle he presides over the Order of Augurs, ensuring that their divine prophecies are chronicled and debated with great care. His wisdom and patience are renowned even among the Archons' enemies.

The Archon Diviners are the enlightened followers of Anon. They dwell at the Lakes of Sagacity, attending to the Order of Augurs and their divine Observatories. When the starlight leads them away from the blessed shores of Emnora, the Archon Diviners will stand against evil and fight for the fulfillment of their prophecies.

GLOBAL.ArachnaLoreConcept.name: Arachna
GLOBAL.ArachnaLoreConcept.description:
A spinner of exquisite crafting, she sings a luring melody from the hidden place, feeling the vibrations in the strings of her many tangled web. The weaver Arachna spins intrigue, ensnaring lost souls that wander into darkness to hide their shame. Her dark servants move about the world, while she lurks deep in the nest of shadows.

Arachna discovered that some Goblins were so distasteful that her beloved spiders refused to consume them. With that, her Reclusive Spiderlings were born. These symbiotic fiends love lurking unnoticed in the recesses of the world. They breed their arachnids, which have now grown to such enormous proportions that they ride them into combat.

GLOBAL.ArcaneInspirationConcept.name: Arcane Inspiration
GLOBAL.ArcaneInspirationConcept.description:
For Mystic Spell Arcanists, each spell has a potential benefit that can be extracted by using it after gaining enough inspiration for it.Combat Spell gain inspiration upon completing a combat in which the spell was used at least once.World Map Spell gain inspiration for each use.
Once a spell has gained maximum inspiration, it can be exploited, locking the spell away temporarily in return for the effects of its potential.
The potential of each spell is randomly assigned, scaling with the tier of the spell. When a spell has been exploited and becomes available again, it will gain a new potential.

GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept.name: Architect
GLOBAL.ArchitectConcept.description: Has higher Production income.Collect Wonderstone to build impressive Monument to the Affinity. Monument grant Affinity Incarnate to Architect Units.Architect culture units deal damage matching the Empire's dominant Affinity.

GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept.name: Artica
GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept.description:
Her icy filigree sparkles, catching iridescent sheets of boreal ghost-light. Think not to captivate this one, for her heart is frigid. Artica haunts the snowy drifts of winter, leaving no footprints. Goddess to her Frostling subjects, they alone tolerate her frigid isolation.

Specialized people who adore the ice and snow, Frostlings thrive in inhospitable glacial realms. Their frigid adaptation allows them to raid the rich lands that border the frozen wastes, spreading their cold unfeeling ice as a blizzard.

GLOBAL.ArtifactHoardConcept.name: Equipment Hoard
GLOBAL.ArtifactHoardConcept.description: Hero Items in the arsenal grant additional Mana income.Tier I - 1 Tier II - 3 Tier III - 5 Tier IV - 9

GLOBAL.ArvikLoreConcept.name: Arvik the Dark
GLOBAL.ArvikLoreConcept.description:
Arvik was a talented necromancer from Athla, standing next to the Elven Court and Commonwealth when his home world was invaded. Together with his people, Arvik was cast into the Astral Void, but the Primal Spirit of the Glacial Mammoth gave him the strength to escape his Torment of Shadows.

The Risen Frostlings originate from Athla, but have since evolved under Arvik's cold rule. They believe power lies in strength of both mind and body, worshiping the resilient Glacial Mammoth as they fight to reclaim their frozen empire once more.

GLOBAL.AscendedInsectoidLoreConcept.name: Naz'ru Ka'zorak
GLOBAL.AscendedInsectoidLoreConcept.description:
Naz'ru isn't the smartest of his people, nor the wisest, or most charismatic. Above all, he is the biggest and the most protective, and among the first to shed the corruption of Urrath. Under his rule, the dwellings of the Shadir'ko have evolved into thriving cities.

The Shadir'ko were once mindless thralls under the rule of Lithyl, corrupted by Urrath. Only after ages of neglect were they able to slowly and through much loss find their own identities, which they now viciously defend.

GLOBAL.AsgeraLoreConcept.name: Asgera Spinesplitter
GLOBAL.AsgeraLoreConcept.description:
Brutality is Asgera Spinesplitter! She rallies her Orcs with a covenant of conquest, and nothing stands forever against her might.

Bloodfang Orcs are not known for their love of flower arranging or carving fruit into the shapes of tiny animals. They do enjoy the rhythm and visual poetry that results from repeatedly bashing a foe's skull against a bloody rock until it caves in with a beautiful scarlet display of fleshy fireworks.

GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept.name: Ashlands
GLOBAL.AshlandsConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A sprawling expanse of gray dust and ash. A Hut can be built here.
Cities with Desolate Adaptation can build a Farm instead.

GLOBAL.AstralAttunementConcept.name: Astral Attunement
GLOBAL.AstralAttunementConcept.description: Links the target race to the Astral Sea, granting them:The Ethereal unit type.Attunement: Astral Omen, granting a random Positive Status Effect when a spell is cast in combat.

GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept.name: Astral Barrens
GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

These lands have been eroded by a wind that rips all forms of magic from everyone and everything.
Magic Origin Unit do not regenerate Hit Point in this province.World Map Spell and Combat Spell cast in this province gain a 20% chance of Backfiring.No Mana income can be gained from this Province.Resource Node in the province become Ruined.Ruined Nodes cannot be restored while this province has Astral Barrens.Terrain cannot be altered by most spells and effects.

GLOBAL.AstralConcept.name: Astral Affinity
GLOBAL.AstralConcept.description:
Astral Affinity seeks to unravel the cosmic powers and harness the pure magic that shapes reality. Associated with Scrying, Illusions, Enchantment, Summoning, and Meta-magic.

Astral Affinity is opposed by Materium Affinity. Empire or Free City with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.AstralEchoConcept.name: Astral Echoes
GLOBAL.AstralEchoConcept.description:
Astral Echoes are special resources gained through:
Astral Echoes Pickup, only visible to and collectible by Ruler of certain Mystic Subcultures.

This resource is used for Echo Casting by the Mystic School of Attunement.

This resource is used for Echo Infusion by the Mystic School of Summoning.

GLOBAL.AyaLoreConcept.name: Aya the Enlightened
GLOBAL.AyaLoreConcept.description:
Aya's gaze has always drifted beyond the limits of the physical realm. It was her mind that elevated her to become guide to her people and ascended her to Godirhood. She has seen many futures and guides her people through them with kindness, but prejudice.

The Simians of the Open Hand value wisdom and harmony above all else, aiming for a life of peace and study. Once threatened, however, they use their inner strength to exploit the weaknesses of their adversaries.

GLOBAL.AzanyaLoreConcept.name: Azanya
GLOBAL.AzanyaLoreConcept.description:
Azanya was a solitary Maer who encountered a wandering wizard in the far reaches of the Astral Sea. Touched by his story and quest to find his lost love, Azanya eventually guided him to a dark realm named Tharru'Cath. She ignored her urge to flee the threatening darkness until it was too late, and both she and her wizard friend were captured. Since then, the corruption of the Umbral Abyss has twisted her into something she barely recognizes.

The Enthralled Syrons are defined by their imprisonment on Tharru'Cath, where they laid eyes on their mythical ruler for the first time. Through better and worse, they follow their ruler's guiding song with a near-mindless fervor.

GLOBAL.BarbarianConcept.name: Barbarian
GLOBAL.BarbarianConcept.description: Has higher Food and Draft income.Units have Savage Strike, dealing extra damage on a Critical Hit.Ritual of Alacrity

GLOBAL.BedrockConcept.name: Bedrock
GLOBAL.BedrockConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Solid, unbreakable bedrock. Not viable for exploitation.

GLOBAL.BhajifLoreConcept.name: Bhajif Erranstar
GLOBAL.BhajifLoreConcept.description:
Be there an ancient artifact to uncover or a cosmic event to unfold, the Wanderer is ever present. Many question whether he follows the Astral Flows to fortune, or whether fortune follows him instead. Is he the moth or the flame?

Bhajif refers to those who follow him as the Lost Travelers, for they walk in the footsteps of a man without direction. When his followers ask Bhajif what path they should take, he always replies: "Travelers, there is no path, for the path is made through walking."

GLOBAL.BirchfootLoreConcept.name: Birchfoot the Hermit
GLOBAL.BirchfootLoreConcept.description:
Birchfoot was never ambitious, but his spiritual visions ensured his rise within Grasshorn society. He is deemed a wise and thoughtful, albeit fretful ruler. When the burden of leadership becomes too heavy, Birchfoot seeks solace in the eye of a thunderstorm, where his connection to the Storm Crow is strongest.

Grasshorns believe themselves to be born from the roots of a lightning bolt, carrying their own likeness of the storms' strikes on their heads. They worship the Storm Crow and see wisdom as their greatest virtue.

GLOBAL.BlintUnderdelverLoreConcept.name: Blint the Underdelver
GLOBAL.BlintUnderdelverLoreConcept.description:
Blint listens. The earth trembles and he hears its murmurs. Patiently he waits below, hoarding his resources, until his means are sufficient to overwhelm the fools who waste their efforts on works of rock and stone to fortify themselves.

Blint's Mole-folk, dubbed by many as the Deep Dwellers, are known for outstanding levels of patience and cunning. They possess the knowledge and instinctive ability to both raise glorious structures as well as tear them down in the most efficient manner possible.

GLOBAL.BroodmasterConcept.name: Broodmaster
GLOBAL.BroodmasterConcept.description: <helpcolor>A ruler of Umbral Thralls, tainted by Urrath's corruption.</helpcolor>

GLOBAL.CaliothLoreConcept.name: Calioth
GLOBAL.CaliothLoreConcept.description:
Once an Archon Titan, Calioth fell during the Archon war against Myrrida. Recently, eldritch magic brutally tore him from his eternal rest, harnessing his rage against enemies he would once call ally. If any spark of light endures within him, it is long buried beneath the shroud of his dark, decaying flesh.

The Ancient Revenants were once Archons who fought and fell in the name of their divine purpose. Even in death, their struggle endures, for the very darkness they fought now pulls their strings.

GLOBAL.CapturedNoWarspoilsConcept.name: Captured
GLOBAL.CapturedNoWarspoilsConcept.description: Captured units may be recruited after combat by spending Gold.

GLOBAL.ChasmConcept.name: Chasm
GLOBAL.ChasmConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A gaping chasm full of lava cuts through this province. City annexing this province suffer -5 City Stability.

GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept.name: Cinren Toliath
GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept.description:
An attractive elf who nevertheless evokes an aura of haughty superiority, Cinren wears a perpetual sneer of lecherous intent. It is said that he has devoted much of his existence to the magical honing of carnal delights, often careening down dark and morally ambiguous pathways in order to reach undiscovered realms of pleasure.

The group of elves known as the Ashborn Hedonists follow Cinren Toliath and revere his godlike pursuit of pleasure. Powerful practitioners of magic in their own right, they seek to bring all under the sway of their master in order to provide more fodder towards his lecherous machinations.

GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept.name: City Stability
GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept.description:
City Stability represents your overall control over a City.
High Stability boosts Food, Draft, and Production income.Low Stability reduces all City Income.Very Low Stability can lead to the city losing Province.It drops as the city's Domain grows, and can be regained by building certain City Structure.
80 to 100: Harmony.40 to 79: Orderly.10 to 39: Stable.-9 to 9: Neutral.-39 to -10: Unstable.-79 to -40: Unrest.-100 to -80: Rioting.

GLOBAL.CityStabilityRioting.name: Rioting
GLOBAL.CityStabilityRioting.description: -50% City Income. There is a chance that the provinces might defect from the city.

GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard.name: Cleansing Flames
GLOBAL.CleansingFlamesHazard.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:Non-Zeal or Faithful suffer Burning.Zeal or Faithful units lose -1 Negative Status Effect.Condemned units lose -1 Positive Status Effect.

GLOBAL.CliffConcept.name: Cliff
GLOBAL.CliffConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A steep cliff formed by a rocky drop-off. A Quarry can be built here.

GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept.name: Combat Casting Point
GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept.description:
These represent your ability to channel the precise magical energies needed to cast Spell during Combat.

They are refilled at the start of each battle.

GLOBAL.CriticalHitChanceConcept.name: Critical Hit Chance
GLOBAL.CriticalHitChanceConcept.description: If a unit's attack is a Critical Hit, its damage is increased by +50%.Critical Hits are usually caused by high Morale.Critical Hit chance can never be higher than an attack's chance to hit.

GLOBAL.CrocodileTempleConcept.name: Mire Crocodile Temple
GLOBAL.CrocodileTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Mire Crocodile Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the provinces gains SwampPer Turn, one of the provinces loses Chasm, Sand, Snow, Ice, Ashlands, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.CrowTempleConcept.name: Storm Crow Temple
GLOBAL.CrowTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Storm Crow Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains Grassland.Per Turn, one of the Provinces loses Chasm, Swamp, Snow, Ice, Ashlands, Sand, and Gloom

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept.name: Crystal Dwelling
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingConcept.description:
Crystal Dwellings are a type of Dwelling inhabited by remnants of the Giant Kings in Lithorine forms.
Only 1 Crystal Dwelling exists within a realm.The only way to improve Allegiance with the Dwelling is through Quests.Having a Pact with the Crystal Dwelling will unlock several trading options with them, such as Tome content, Artifact, Lithorine Unit, and revealing points of interests on the map.Once captured, a Crystal Dwelling is immediately destroyed and awards some of the Dwelling's trade items to the conqueror.

GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingStonePactConcept.name: Stone Pact
GLOBAL.CrystalDwellingStonePactConcept.description: The Crystal Dwelling opens its borders.Unlocks purchase of the following trade items via Cooperation:Lithorite ScrollLithorine NeedlerGoldseekers pickaxeLithorite orbShatter bladesTitans greatbowCompleting Dwelling quests rewards guaranteed hero items in addition to their other rewards.

GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept.name: Alliance
GLOBAL.DSAllianceConcept.description: The strongest bond two Player can share. While in an alliance, allied victories are possible when enabled, and Player are automatically called for aid in War. Both sides will return their captured heroes.

GLOBAL.DafalDeaLoreConcept.name: Dafal Dea
GLOBAL.DafalDeaLoreConcept.description:
When the sharp mind of an Amphibian is driven by a divine calling, it can reach quite erudite heights. When, as in the case of Dafal, it ascends to roaming the seas to bring justice, it becomes a force to be reckoned with indeed.

The followers of Dafal Dea are as zealous as they are naturally amphibious. Long conversations about philosophy and Godirhood can often be heard drifting through the sea fog, to the accompaniment of excited croaks, when one of their vessels is close by.

GLOBAL.DarkConcept.name: Dark
GLOBAL.DarkConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Aggressive units that focus on damage over defense and healing.</bullet><bullet>Exploit defeated enemy heroes, depending on the chosen subculture.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.DecimusLoreConcept.name: Decimus the Unwavering
GLOBAL.DecimusLoreConcept.description:
Decimus was hand-picked by Nimue as a Ruler of her then latest created race, and proudly named Nimue's tenth favorite. He wore this honor with pride and responsibility, until his creator Goddess grew disappointed with him and his people for reasons unknown to any but herself. It was this guilt that led him to pursue a life of righteousness for him and his people, and it was this weight of responsibility that started him on his path to ascension.

The Atoning Toadmen were created by Nimue and once rose above many others, but must now answer for their sins. What sins and how, they are not sure, but they must atone nonetheless, and lead others on the same path of righteousness before their former Goddess, Nimue, can love them again.

GLOBAL.DeepOceanConcept.name: Deep Ocean
GLOBAL.DeepOceanConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

Oceans can only be traversed through seafaring.

GLOBAL.DefaultPersonalityConcept.name: Default Personality
GLOBAL.DefaultPersonalityConcept.description: The default personality makes sure that the system will choose a personality for this Ruler automatically when it is AI controlled. Each personality has ties to one or several Affinity and may also have a preferred Alignment, the combination of these, at the start of a session, determines which personality will be chosen automatically for your ruler if you encounter them as an AI ruler.

GLOBAL.DefaultVictoryConcept.name: Military Victory
GLOBAL.DefaultVictoryConcept.description: To achieve the Military Victory, an Empire needs to defeat all other Non-Allied empires. To defeat an empire, its Ruler needs to be Forced into the Astral Void and its Throne City must be captured. If a Ruler is forced into the Astral Void, they will respawn at their Throne City unless it is captured by another empire.

GLOBAL.DemonkinConcept.name: Demonkin
GLOBAL.DemonkinConcept.description: Turns the target race into demonic beings, which grants them:The Infernal Fiend unit type.Flying, increasing mobility.Frenzy, increasing damage as they attack.City of this race ignore the City Stability penalty from Chasm and Lava in their Domain.

GLOBAL.DenounceConcept.name: Denounce
GLOBAL.DenounceConcept.description:
A denouncement is a verbal warning about a Grievance that affects the targeted Ruler and their relations with other AI Rulers that you both have met.

A Ruler may only be denounced once for each unique Grievance a Ruler has against them.

Denouncing a Ruler using Fabricated Grievance will cause them to have a grievance against you!

Denouncements can be made through Pronouncement.

GLOBAL.DestinyTraitConcept.name: Racial Destiny Traits
GLOBAL.DestinyTraitConcept.description:
When a race adapts to its surroundings and the actions of their race keeper, the race council may decide to proclaim a new era for their people. When they do, they approach the race keeper in an event, where it is decided if this change will manifest into a destiny trait.

Destiny traits change a race's Affinity or Alignment and need to be accepted with care, since they come with an inherent up- and downside.

GLOBAL.Devotion0Concept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.Devotion0Concept.description: A neutral devotion level without broad benefits or detriments.

GLOBAL.DevouringVoidConcept.name: Devouring Void
GLOBAL.DevouringVoidConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:Sustain 30 Physical DamageLose 3 Morale

GLOBAL.DistractingConcept.name: Distracting
GLOBAL.DistractingConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become Distracted for 1 Turn.

GLOBAL.DomeOfProtectionConcept.name: Dome of Protection
GLOBAL.DomeOfProtectionConcept.description: Units with Zeal or Faithful gain:+2 Defense.+2 Resistance.+2 Status Resistance.

GLOBAL.DragonHoardConcept.name: Dragon Hoard
GLOBAL.DragonHoardConcept.description: Hero Items in the Dragon's arsenal grant additional Gold income.Tier I - 1 Tier II - 3 Tier III - 5 Tier IV - 9

GLOBAL.DungeonConcept.name: Dungeon
GLOBAL.DungeonConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Underground terrain shaped into a fortified structure.

GLOBAL.EchoCastingConcept.name: Echo Casting
GLOBAL.EchoCastingConcept.description:
Echo casting allows the use of Astral Echoes to replace casting points, letting the user cast spells beyond the limit their casting points would otherwise allow.

Tactical spells that cost more Combat Casting Point than remain may substitute them with Astral Echoes.
Strategic spells may be rushed while they are priming in the spellbook, costing Astral Echoes to substitute the remaining World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.EchoInfusionConcept.name: Echo Infusion
GLOBAL.EchoInfusionConcept.description:
Echo Infusion allows the use of Astral Echoes to empower Magic Origin units granting them additional ranks.

The cost of this infusion is based on the remaining Experience required before the unit reaches the next rank.

GLOBAL.EdwardLoreConcept.name: Edward Portsmith
GLOBAL.EdwardLoreConcept.description:
Ever the resourceful and honest dreadnought, Edward Portsmith has been a beacon of hope for many who still uphold the values of the Commonwealth. Since the World Seals on Athla were opened, his legend has only grown. Playing the role of the hero, however, can take its toll on those who don't process their own torment.

The soldiers of the Commonwealth were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the Astral Sea. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.

GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignConcept.name: Eldritch Sovereign
GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignConcept.description:
An eldritch sorcerer commanding powers beyond mortal comprehension.
Eldritch Sovereigns have access to powerful control Hero Skills.Eldritch Sovereigns gain powerful unique Hero Signature Skills.Use Thrall to cast powerful ritual Spell.Start with Clairvoyance Ritual and Enthrall Population.Eldritch Sovereigns are Eldritch Governor.Eldritch Sovereigns have a 5 Mana Unit Upkeep and cannot equip Leg and Mount items.

GLOBAL.ElectricallyChargedConcept.name: Electrically Charged
GLOBAL.ElectricallyChargedConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become Electrified for {timer} Turn.

GLOBAL.EmbalmedSacrificeConcept.name: Embalmed Sacrifices
GLOBAL.EmbalmedSacrificeConcept.description:
Embalmed Sacrifices are gained by Embalming Heroes in your Crypt.

Embalmed Sacrifices are used by the Dark Cult of Death for powerful city structures and a unique strategic spell.

GLOBAL.EternalCouncilConcept.name: Council Prolocutor
GLOBAL.EternalCouncilConcept.description: <helpcolor>Souls of ancient Elder Giants encased in crystal, who govern their Crystal Dwelling with a singular voice.</helpcolor>

GLOBAL.ExplosiveConcept.name: Explosive
GLOBAL.ExplosiveConcept.description: This obstacle will explode when destroyed, dealing damage to adjacent units.

GLOBAL.FangirLoreConcept.name: Fangir
GLOBAL.FangirLoreConcept.description:
When the stars light up the night's sky, it is said they are sparks from Fangir's Astral anvil. Once a talented Dwarven artificer, Fangir traveled to the Astral Sea and emerged with expanding interests. Where first he controlled rock and earth, he now aims to mold the Astral Flows themselves.

Originating from Athlan Dwarves, the Moonrock Dwarves are great builders and runesmiths. When they followed Fangir into the Astral Sea to hunt for riches, they emerged with new insights and aspirations. Why dig and fight for one realm, when the stars themselves are there to be mined?

GLOBAL.FausterTheMeticulousLoreConcept.name: Fauster the Meticulous
GLOBAL.FausterTheMeticulousLoreConcept.description:
In a harsh society where the strongest thrived, Fauster was the weakest chick in a nest of seven. It was his intelligence and social aptitude that helped him survive and even thrive. Fauster has since then more than made up for his physical disadvantage and become the Avian Reavers' Master Alchemist.

The society of Avian Reavers took shape by their ruler's discovery of alchemy and Magelock weaponry, which revolutionized their so-called "primitive" heritage into a society of science and more efficient shows of force. Before, one's tail feathers decided one's social successes. Now the size of their guns and explosions matter most.

GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept.name: Grassland
GLOBAL.FertilePlainsConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Rolling fields of fertile grassland. A Farm can be built here.

GLOBAL.FflammychLoreConcept.name: Fflammych Fyre-Heart
GLOBAL.FflammychLoreConcept.description:
Like many of his kin, Fflammych was born and raised amidst the rivalry between Giants and Dragons. As the guardian of his hearth, Fflammych has seen many a battle and has always protected his kin and people with fire and blood. Recently, however, revelations of greater dangers than Dragons have dimmed the vengeance in his heart. Some say he even dares to question the ancient rivalries.

Fflammych's Hearthkin believe their Souls are forged in the heart of their Giant King, and thus they follow Fflammych with unwavering loyalty. As wielders of the soul-flame, their pyromancers are revered like priests.

GLOBAL.FjallaLoreConcept.name: Fjalla Tor-Builder
GLOBAL.FjallaLoreConcept.description:
A proud descendant of the Giant Kings of old, Fjalla carries the responsibility of her royal ancestors on her shoulders. Her father taught her about the beauty of Myrrida, and Fjalla vowed to see its glory reborn.

Fjalla's Jordvolk are proud artisans whose ancestry dates back to the empire of Myrrida, where they served Giant King Thrudgelmir before they pledged their loyalty to his daughter. Under the rule of Fjalla, they honed their craft to perfection, and feel confident of bringing the glory of Myrrida to the Realms once more.

GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept.name: Flora
GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept.description: Flora Obstacles are all obstacles that are plants.

GLOBAL.ForeignCityConcept.name: Foreign City
GLOBAL.ForeignCityConcept.description: City belonging to an Empire other than your own.

GLOBAL.ForestConcept.name: Forest
GLOBAL.ForestConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A province full of various trees. A Forester can be built here.

GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept.name: The Devouring Winds
GLOBAL.FracturingWindsConcept.description:
The Devouring Winds make casting World Map Spell dangerous, eventually culminating in a Cataclysm.
Casting a World Map Spell adds its World Map Casting Point cost to the Cataclysm Meter.When the Cataclysm meter is filled to 50% or more, Province become marked for the next Cataclysm.When the Cataclysm Meter reaches the maximum. a Cataclysm is triggered.The higher the Level of the Cataclysm Meter, the more Provinces will be marked and struck during a Cataclysm.The Cataclysm Meter decreases by 10 per Turn.For every Level of the Cataclysm Meter, all Spell have 10% chance of Backfiring.

GLOBAL.FredricLoreConcept.name: Fredric the Twice-Cursed
GLOBAL.FredricLoreConcept.description:
The fate of Fredric is a tragic one: cursed in life by the Lizardfolk and again in death by Urrath's followers, Fredric and his kin of Archon descendants rose as undead Revenants, driven by evil. Yet when the seals on Athla were shattered, their souls broke free from Urrath's vile influence.

Since then, Fredric seeks a cure to the Revenant curse, fighting for the right of his people to exist and retain their Archon legacy.

GLOBAL.FrikkaLoreConcept.name: Frikka Dynosis
GLOBAL.FrikkaLoreConcept.description:
Frikka is an ancient Godir in the guise of a Halfling, with a penchant for cunning and frivolity. Her sharp mind and quicker wit are testament to the time spent learning from the Archons before their withdrawal. Ever a fickle being, her motivations are as changeable as the winds. Mischief and mayhem are interchangeable with seemingly selfless acts of kindness that leave those who deal with her reeling with confusion and reaching for an understanding that is simply unattainable!

The Gleeful Miscreants are the aptly named race of rat-like folk that worship Frikka as master and muse. They delight in the mischief she is so talented in sowing and will, at her behest, occasionally pretend to capture her in order to lure in hapless would-be rescuers. Like Frikka herself, their looks often serve to deceive those who gaze upon them and see only helpless vermin.

GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept.name: Ice
GLOBAL.FrozenWasteConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A sprawl of icy flats. A Hut can be built here.

GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept.name: Fungus Fields
GLOBAL.FungusFieldsConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Sprawling fields full of nutritious mushrooms. A Farm can be built here, but factions without Underground Adaptation will suffer -2 Food.

GLOBAL.GaiasChosenConcept.name: Gaia's Chosen
GLOBAL.GaiasChosenConcept.description: Infuse the target race with the blessing of Nature. They gain:The Plant unit type.Negative Status Effect last -1 Turn, with a minimum of 1.+3 Status Resistance.+20 Hit Point.

GLOBAL.GloomHooknailLoreConcept.name: Gloom Hooknail
GLOBAL.GloomHooknailLoreConcept.description:
Gloom Hooknail, the Dark Lady, rewards cruelty. She is fickle and deliberately impulsive, keeping her servants in a state of constant fear while competing for her favor. She loves cruel assassins and rewards the most deplorable acts of depravity, for they amuse her.

They creep deep in the dark, which they love and despise. Corrupted Goblins see the fair and laughing souls and let hate and envy fill them. They may not be strong in might, but their minds are devious and filled with a cruelty that horrifies.

GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept.name: Gloom
GLOBAL.GloomTerrainConcept.description:
Gloom terrain is normally only found in the Umbral Abyss.

Unit except Marauder within Gloom provinces suffer Umbral Malady, and City suffer -10 City Stability for every annexed Gloom Province within their Domain.

GLOBAL.GoldtouchedConcept.name: Goldtouched
GLOBAL.GoldtouchedConcept.description: Makes the target race gain an affinity for gold, granting them:+2 Resistance.+1 Gold per Population in their City.

GLOBAL.HamBingerLoreConcept.name: Ham Binger
GLOBAL.HamBingerLoreConcept.description:
Ham Binger is a legendary Halfling whose curiosity endowed him with a form of immortality that is unique among his people. Notorious for escaping impossible situations, his people know that when Ham disappears, it’s time to make oneself scarce.

Wholesome Halflings pursue a life of simple joys and unsophisticated celebration. They thrive in communities that harbor cooperation, raising livestock and farming verdant hills.

GLOBAL.HeroConcept.name: Hero
GLOBAL.HeroConcept.description:
Heroes are important units that can lead Army and become powerful battle Unit.
Heroes are immune to Final Ultimatum and Dominated.

They are needed to:Explore Ancient Wonder.Initiate a Siege.Govern City.Build Outpost.
If a Hero dies and the opponent is victorious, the Hero will go to their Prison or Crypt.

GLOBAL.HighConcept.name: High
GLOBAL.HighConcept.description: Has higher City Stability and Knowledge income.Units are strengthened with Awakened, revealing their hidden potential.Alignment Agenda.

GLOBAL.HighMoraleConcept.name: High
GLOBAL.HighMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is in high spirits and confident of victory.

Effects:20% Critical Hit Chance

GLOBAL.HostageAllegianceConcept.name: Hostage Diplomacy
GLOBAL.HostageAllegianceConcept.description: The Dark Subculture "Cult of Tyranny" uses heroes in their prison to take control of Free Cities and exploit Vassals.Defeated Hero belonging to Free City become Hostages in your Prison.Hostages provide Allegiance every turn and count as an assigned Whispering Stone.Conquered Cities released as Vassals also immediately grant you a Hostage.When Vassalizing a city that belonged to another Empire, all Hero of that empire in your prison become hostages of this new Vassal instead.

GLOBAL.HrimisLoreConcept.name: Hrímis Glacier-Carver
GLOBAL.HrimisLoreConcept.description:
Hrímis was a Giant serving the ancient Giant Kings until the Giant Empire of Myrrida fell to the combined forces of Archons and Dragons. Since then, she has been a recluse and avoids any contact with outsiders unless absolutely necessary. Perhaps the encroaching corruption by the Umbral Abyss is one such necessity.

The Kaldbörn are the devoted servants of Hrímis, thriving within the frigid depths of the underground. Much like their Empress, they shun direct conflict, choosing instead to observe from the shadows as great empires crumble.

GLOBAL.HutConcept.name: Hut
GLOBAL.HutConcept.description:
A hut is a Province Improvement that is available in extreme environments when a race does not have the adaptation to build farms in that climate.

A hut provides food but not as much as a farm.

GLOBAL.HykaLoreConcept.name: Hyka-Tha Agatare
GLOBAL.HykaLoreConcept.description:
In life, Hyka-Tha was a Grand Architect, known, respected, and revered. In death, she has risen as the advocate of the Awakened. Upon regaining consciousness, she sought her former allies for guidance and support in her corrupted state... But her prayers were answered with a sword wreathed in flames. Now, she wages war—not for vengeance, but for her kin.

More and more Awakened gather under Hyka-Tha's command. Now that they have regained awareness, they ask themselves: If the living also destroy and consume relentlessly, why are the undead denied the right to exist? And so, the deceased raise their necropolises—and their fallen kin—building an empire for those who once fell.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept.name: Neutral diplomatic state with a Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityNeutralConcept.description: The default Diplomatic State. The Free City and the Empire have not yet negotiated any better terms. This can be done using a Whispering Stone.

GLOBAL.IndustriousConcept.name: Industrious
GLOBAL.IndustriousConcept.description: Has higher Production income.Through Bolstering, units get sturdier as they get hit in battle.Scout Prospecting.

GLOBAL.InsectoidWardenLoreConcept.name: Ryc'turi
GLOBAL.InsectoidWardenLoreConcept.description:
Once, Ryc'Turi was nothing but one drone in the hive-mind of her people, following the orders of their Sovereign Lithyl without question. In her absence, however, Ryc'Turi was the first of her people to take initiative beyond the direct orders she was given. Where this newly-found ambition will lead her, she herself hardly knows.

Born and raised on Tharru'Cath, the Shadac'har know very little beyond oppressive violence and blind loyalty to Urrath and their overlords. Over time, however, they developed the power to communicate with other peoples and started to show an eagerness to build that their former Sovereign would undoubtedly deem mildly concerning.

GLOBAL.JuliaLoreConcept.name: Julia of House Inioch
GLOBAL.JuliaLoreConcept.description:
The last remaining Keeper of Life, Empress Julia stood against Death’s bloody star, defending flawed mortality even when its forces unleashed plagues upon a pristine paradise. She is one of the few remaining ancient immortal elves, uncorrupted by the ages and hardship she has endured. Torn from her family and homeland by Lithyl Nightweaver, Julia was captured in the Umbral Abyss and forced to watch helplessly as Merlin traded his soul for her freedom. Despite it all, she balances life's resilience, allies with the peaceable way of nature, and despises those with vast ambitions and narrow visions.

The Exalted Elves have flocked to Julia like moths to a kind and peaceful flame. Like Julia, they aim to bring peace to ravaged realms, rebuilding them in harmony with nature.

GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept.name: Karissa the Red
GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept.description:
Love and hate burn as blinding embers in Karissa’s lusty savage eyes. She claims the impulse that drives life to the brink of violence. Strength begets strength. Ruthlessly, she will crush any weakness and they praise her for it. She is the true flame burning in the bosom of every mortal being.

Trusting in axe and spear, Enthralled Orcs crush their enemies. Every tradition is focused upon the sole purpose of domination and destruction. They enslave weaker beings to do the disparaging tasks like farming and gathering resources, but the best treasures are plundered from the soft.

GLOBAL.KhirUranonLoreConcept.name: Khir Uranon
GLOBAL.KhirUranonLoreConcept.description:
The name Khir Uranon has often been spoken in dreaded whisper. Those that know his name know him to be a demonic manipulator, whose mastery of the forge is fueled by a callous disregard for the souls he infuses his creations with.

The Blackfurred Forgelings are known for their prodigious strength and merciless cruelty, both aspects forged in the fires of their masters' ancient crucibles. Here, they help him utilize the souls of those that fall before them to power demonic artifacts.

GLOBAL.KledasLoreConcept.name: Kledas the Artist
GLOBAL.KledasLoreConcept.description:
Kledas once created for the Archons, uniting nature and megaliths into breathtaking works of art. But his ambition drove him to create a wonder that defied the gods; and for that, he was cast out to suffer the Torment of Shadows. Now, Kledas roams the world, searching Wonders for remnants of his lost creations, desperate to remember who he was... and what he was capable of.

The Dwarves who follow Kledas are both his worshipers and his pupils. They consider him the ultimate artist, a creator of poetry in timeless forms. Every pupil strives to express their art in an unique way, guided by the teachings of their tormented master.

GLOBAL.KruulBlightlordLoreConcept.name: Kruul Blightlord
GLOBAL.KruulBlightlordLoreConcept.description:
Kruul embodies the prowess of his kin, despising any lies propagated against his people. He especially hates the one regarding their origins that suggests they were the result of a Godir's experimentation crossbreeding rodents and humans, and that in a moment of bloodlust they ate their own creator. Any hint of that story will drive him into a murderous frenzy.

The Fiendish Rodents strive to embody their master's best qualities. As such, they are driven by an insatiable bloodlust and almost gleeful addiction to malevolence and pain.

GLOBAL.LaryssaLoreConcept.name: Laryssa Mirabilis
GLOBAL.LaryssaLoreConcept.description:
A powerful and cunning sorceress of Athla, Laryssa Mirabilis has played a pivotal role in forming the Torchbearers, who revealed a grand conspiracy involving Athla's most powerful nations. After being cast adrift together with her companion Edward Portsmith, Laryssa has used her skills to keep her people alive and their ideals upheld.

Laryssa's followers are those who value the spirit over the letter of the law. Rather than a supreme ruler, the Commonwealth Philosophers are led by a council that Laryssa represents. To these sorcerers, politics and intrigue are like a game of chess, and they take glee in playing it.

GLOBAL.LeaderConcept.name: Ruler
GLOBAL.LeaderConcept.description:
A Ruler is a unit who both represents and leads an Empire. They can lead Army and become powerful battle Unit.

Like a Hero, they are needed to:Explore Ancient Wonder.Initiate a Siege.Govern City.Build Outpost.
If a Ruler loses all of their HP in battle, they are Forced into the Astral Void.
If a Ruler is forced into the Astral Void and their Throne City is captured, they lose the game.

GLOBAL.LithylLoreConcept.name: Lithyl Nightweaver
GLOBAL.LithylLoreConcept.description:
Rumors surround the origins of enigmatic Lithyl Nightweaver, the half-masked wizard who seemed to appear from the Astral Void itself. Shortly after her arrival on Magehaven she joined the Shad'rai on their quest for power over others. Charming and conniving, she seems to be one of many mad Godir, haunted by her Torment of Shadows. But Lithyl specifically stands out for her talent of appearing and disappearing at opportune times.

Not all who wander the Astral Sea are Godir. Many mortals find themselves lost in its depths, forgotten, with no divine power to save them. One Godir has taken it upon herself to save these lost souls. Lithyl Nightweaver reaches out an eldritch hand to pull the Forgotten Ones from the void, no matter how haunted and scarred it left them. Whatever her ulterior motives may be, Lithyl has won her people's undying devotion.

GLOBAL.LithylTrueLoreConcept.name: Lithyl Nightweaver (True Form)
GLOBAL.LithylTrueLoreConcept.description:
Once a powerful Wizard, Lithyl Nightweaver fell to her Torment of Shadows and became Lost, before the dark god Urrath twisted her blind insanity and broken body into something considerably more menacing. After a time of imprisonment wrought upon her by the Elven princess Sundren, Lithyl returns to exact her revenge on her captor, Athla, and the entire Astral Sea.

Not all who wander the Astral Sea are Godir. Many mortals find themselves lost in its depths, forgotten, with no divine power to save them. Still, some may consider oblivion a more merciful fate than to be found by Lithyl Nightweaver, the Harbinger of Urrath, who extends an eldritch hand and strangles those in her grasp until they are nothing but mindless thralls in her game of corruption.

GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept.name: Low
GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is wavering and doubtful of victory.

Effects:Fumble Chance: 20%.

GLOBAL.MaelLoreConcept.name: Mael
GLOBAL.MaelLoreConcept.description:
Her mother was the ocean, her father the storm. Mael was born from the fury of a tempest, there where the sea meets the sky. Sailors swear she is the voice that follows the lightning, the Singer of Storms. And so they chant her song when black clouds darken their sails, praying for her mercy.

If you have ever crossed the sea, you have heard the tale of those who ride the waves, belting out the oncoming storm. The story of a civilization who harmonize and magically amplify their voices to sing with the tempest—or to summon it. Some even say that this is why the primordial appears in the likeness of an Elf, drawn by the devotion of the Storm Choir.

GLOBAL.MagelockLoreConcept.name: Magelock Weaponry
GLOBAL.MagelockLoreConcept.description:
Magelock weapons are magic-powered ranged weapons, derived from the ordnance created by mighty empires long since fallen. By fusing the arcane with the physical, Magelock mechanisms allow skilled marksmen to hit faraway targets with great impact and accuracy.

Magelock weaponry permeates all corners of the Astral Sea, implying analogous origins on various realms, yet the remnants of the ruined Commonwealth remain most infamous for wielding these terrible weapons.

GLOBAL.MagicStrikeConcept.name: Magic Strike
GLOBAL.MagicStrikeConcept.description:
Magic Strikes are a type of Magic attack with a range of 1 hex.

They are available to Magic Fighter Unit and Hero with Magic Strike weapons.

GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept.name: Magic Victory
GLOBAL.MagicVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Magic Victory, an Empire needs to cast and sustain a number of Bind Gold Ancient Wonder spells, unlocked when you choose a Tier III Tome.

When you choose a Tier V Tome, you unlock the Magic Victory Spell of the same affinity as the tome. You may cast it when having enough Bound Ancient Wonders.

Channeling the spell takes 15 Turn until victory is achieved. If you lose a bound Ancient Wonder and would no longer have a sufficient amount, the spell will be canceled.

GLOBAL.MalielLoreConcept.name: Maliel
GLOBAL.MalielLoreConcept.description:
When the Archons cast their Celestial hosts into war, Archpaladin Maliel steers his heavenly chariot headmost. With cleansing flame he descends on the wicked and with zealous conviction he drills his sacred warriors. He is a Paragon of the Order of Highmen and as such propagates their beliefs across the Astral Sea.

The Highmen are the disciples of an Archon Order with high emphasis on martial prowess. Their history is deeply interwoven with the Human race, who they fostered on many Worlds Within. Through virtuous lives some of those Humans would then ascend to Archonhood—and become Highmen themselves.

GLOBAL.MammothTempleConcept.name: Glacial Mammoth Temple
GLOBAL.MammothTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Glacial Mammoth Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains Snow and IcePer Turn, one of the Provinces loses Chasm, Grassland, Swamp, River, Ashlands, Sand, Cavern Floor, Fungus Fields, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.MateriumConcept.name: Materium Affinity
GLOBAL.MateriumConcept.description:
Materium Affinity relates to physical magic. It is associated with resource extraction, transmutation and mastery over the mundane physical world.

Materium Affinity is opposed by Astral Affinity. Empire or Free City with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.

GLOBAL.MeandorLoreConcept.name: Meandor
GLOBAL.MeandorLoreConcept.description:
A harbinger of intrigue, Meandor is the first Prince of the ancient tradition of Dark Elves. He plots against allies and enemies alike. He once experienced death and found it unsatisfying. He now respects his sister Julia, but won't hesitate to stab a dagger through her plans. His followers see him as a symbol of vengeance, but he prefers to shirk ideologies. He revels in remaining a wild card in the realm of diplomatic games. Yet, he, too, is haunted by his own demons.

Dark Elves lurk in the deep shadows, plotting vengeance upon humanity and the fair races that tolerate them. They will never forget how men stole their lands. Dark Elves enslave weaker races and train them in cruelty, using them to achieve their nefarious purposes. They are masters of stealth, known to favor a well placed blade in the back over a fair fight.

GLOBAL.MegairaLoreConcept.name: Megaira the Scalded
GLOBAL.MegairaLoreConcept.description:
Megaira was born in the fires of her burning parental home. Since then she has fought for her place in the world of the Pyrekin. She has slain many who challenged her, and even more who happened to be in her way, with tooth and fist if necessary. Thus, she was given the title of Thornfist.

The Pyrekin believe they were born from the heart of the flame that devours the worlds, and thus they need to feed the flame in their hearts. No challenge unanswered, no deed undone, they charge into battle like an inferno and burn all they deem unworthy.

GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept.name: Melenis
GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept.description:
The cruelest Dark Elf assassins revere this Godir, Dancer of Death, Melenis. Once the lithe mistress to Prince Meandor, she died and rose a deadly creature of undeath. Vanquished in that form, she revived anew as queen to Dark Elf assassins. Some say her mad dance between life and death leaves her fixated upon vengeance. Her bitter life taught her that all succumb to death and only fools dare hope.

These sinister Undead Lichbringers seek to master the ghastly secrets of their deadly mistress, Melenis. They tread a trail of stolen lives, steeped in tragedy. They know of no atrocity that will stay their hand from the relentless pursuit of life and death and unlife and undeath, through cultic means and forbidden lore.

GLOBAL.MerlinLoreConcept.name: Merlin
GLOBAL.MerlinLoreConcept.description:
As a young human prince, Merlin was chosen by the Archon Gabriel to restore the balance of power on Athla. The Wizard's Circle, the All-Devourer, the Shadowborn—as a masterful wizard of the cosmos, Merlin protected the people of Athla throughout the Ages even after he had withdrawn from power, exploring large parts of the Astral Sea. At last he was betrayed by his own love, falling into the clutches of Lithyl Nightweaver in a desperate attempt to save Julia of House Inioch from Urrath's grasp. Now, reshaped into an Eldritch Sovereign through Urrath's vile corruption, all that Merlin desires appears to be for the cosmos to swiftly end so that all suffering and agony of the world may forever be forgotten.

The Umbral Humans are Merlin's instrument of annihilation. They bring oblivion to the realms he treads, as oblivion is what their master desires.

GLOBAL.MesharaLoreConcept.name: Meshara the Radiant
GLOBAL.MesharaLoreConcept.description:
Meshara grew up as the daughter of a knight and a priest. Her people say divine righteousness runs through her blood. Yet, she tries to stay humble—or as humble as one can be, when one is named the Prophetess of her entire people.

The Archons are said to be the most legendary protectors of the worlds, and the Human Paladins believe themselves to be a close second. Led by their Prophetess, they aim to bring justice to all living beings on the realms they decide to save.

GLOBAL.MoistConcept.name: Water
GLOBAL.MoistConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become Wet for 3 Turn.

GLOBAL.MountainConcept.name: Mountain
GLOBAL.MountainConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A habitable province with some mountains. A Quarry can be built here.

GLOBAL.MushroomForestConcept.name: Mushroom Forest
GLOBAL.MushroomForestConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A dense forest full of enormous mushrooms. A Forester can be built here.

GLOBAL.MysticConcept.name: Mystic
GLOBAL.MysticConcept.description: Has higher Mana income.Powerful interactions with Spell, depending on their subculture.

GLOBAL.NekronLoreConcept.name: Nekron the Risen
GLOBAL.NekronLoreConcept.description:
Driven by hunger, Nekron brings death to everyone and anyone impartially. He prefers to rule cities of undead, freed from disturbing qualities like free thought and disobedience. Control your emotions, for Nekron is attracted to suffering.

The Cruel Deathbringers were once something one could call Human. Now, they are little more than soulless husks who follow the bidding of their Arch Lich.

GLOBAL.NeutralMoraleConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.NeutralMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is content and ready for battle.

Effects:None.

GLOBAL.NimueLoreConcept.name: Nimue
GLOBAL.NimueLoreConcept.description:
Her mind is a torrent of unpredictable chaos. She wills it and her children rise from the surge, breathing her very lifeblood. Like the tide beating against the changing coastline, so too is Nimue among the Godir. Her power is undeniable, yet her moods swirl like waves in a tide pool. Her children all accept that, inevitably, all will find themselves drowned in a watery grave.

Obsequious and ever condescending, Nimue's Chosen Children know that their time as her favored creations is limited, and if they're not careful, they will all end up drowned in the depths. Fortunately, these clever amphibians have an affinity for water, and know ways of quietly slipping beneath the surface when her storms start churning up the muck.

GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept.name: Noctus
GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept.description:
Only one day after being named High Chancellor of his people, Noctus was poisoned. His feats of necromancy allowed him to not only return from the Astral Void as a Wizard King, but also to bring back the souls of his forefathers, who taught him the secrets of death and eternity... and exacted revenge on those who wronged him.

The Erudite Orcs share an almost obsessive interest in history and death. Always searching for a way to extend their massive libraries, they thread the needle between archaeology and grave robbing as they sometimes bring back the dead themselves to verify their research.

GLOBAL.OathOfHarmony.name: Oath of Harmony
GLOBAL.OathOfHarmony.description: Gain Devotion by:Having a City or Vassal of another Race +20 .Clearing an Infestation or Ancient Wonder +15 .Making a Truce +10 .Forgiving a Grievance +5 .Lose Devotion by:Starting a War -30 .Razing or Migrating a hostile City -20 .Fabricating a Grievance -20 .

GLOBAL.OathOfRighteousness.name: Oath of Righteousness
GLOBAL.OathOfRighteousness.description: Gain Devotion by:Having good alignment, +1 per point.Lose Devotion by:Having evil alignment, -1 per point.

GLOBAL.OathOfStrife.name: Oath of Strife
GLOBAL.OathOfStrife.description: Gain Devotion by:Entering War +15 .Razing a City +10 .Not letting units rout in events +5 .Winning in combat:With lower army power +4 .With higher army power +2 .Lose Devotion by:Entering a Truce -20 , Defensive Pact -15 , or Alliance -30 .Making a Pact of Vassalage -20 .Losing an owned City -10 .

GLOBAL.OathswornConcept.name: Oathsworn
GLOBAL.OathswornConcept.description: Has higher Draft income.Swear Devotion to an oath that guides their people.

GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept.name: Obscuring
GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept.description: Units in this location gain Obscured.

GLOBAL.OceanConcept.name: Ocean
GLOBAL.OceanConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

One or more bodies of water is present in this province. A water Farm can be built here.

GLOBAL.OnFireConcept.name: On Fire
GLOBAL.OnFireConcept.description:
Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with Burning.
Has a chance of spreading to nearby flammable obstacles.

GLOBAL.OneronLoreConcept.name: O'neron
GLOBAL.OneronLoreConcept.description:
Born as a thrall within the Umbral Abyss, O'neron returned his people their freedom when he joined arms with the Wizard Kings of the Second Age on Athla to destroy the All-Devourer. Since then, he has traveled the Astral Sea, reaching other realms of free Syron civilizations. Through the Gloomwatch, he rediscovered his history and heritage, forever linked to Athla.

The Gloomwatch Syrons sail the Astral Sea in search and protection of the Dreamers. They are gifted in the arcane and have developed high versatility when resisting the fell reach of Urrath and its Umbral Abyss.

GLOBAL.OttoDiscardedLoreConcept.name: Otto the Discarded
