GLOBAL.OttoDiscardedLoreConcept.description:
Once, Otto was Nimue's eighth favorite, and for a short while everything was good. Being abandoned by his Goddess initiated his ascension to Godirhood, although he fears what these powers may do to him. Now he leads the people who call themselves Recreants, wearing the shame of Nimue's abandonment as a banner. Whether Godirhood is a blessing or a curse to the created Otto… only time will tell.

The Drowned Recreants were once named Nimue's Chosen Children and a friend to beast and man alike. They were loved by their Goddess, and they loved her in return. She, however, eventually grew disappointed with their flaws and discarded them, drowning many in her wrath. Now, those who remain call themselves the Drowned Recreants and are trying to start a civilization of their own, though many still fear the wrath of their former Goddess.

GLOBAL.PersonalityDislikeConcept.name: Dislike
GLOBAL.PersonalityDislikeConcept.description: Dislikes are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determines which Actions or statuses of another Ruler they will dislike. Relations with Rulers that trigger these dislikes will incur a relation penalty.

GLOBAL.PetrasCelenaLoreConcept.name: Petras Celena
GLOBAL.PetrasCelenaLoreConcept.description:
There have always been people like Petras: those born with such a profound sensitivity to the stars that the constellations themselves emerge upon their flesh. But destiny had something even greater prepared for Petras, and so she awakened the Eye of Prophecies. For she is the Weaver of Fates, the one who mends unraveled destinies and guides the Children of the Stars.

As Oracles read the skies, the Stars' Children read their own skin, following the dictates of their marks as a duty to fulfill. They are guided towards mysterious tasks, whose consequences they do not seek to understand. Yet, some whisper that their Weaver is able to see the threads combine into the greater story called the Tapestry of Destiny.

GLOBAL.PlayerConcept.name: Players
GLOBAL.PlayerConcept.description: A player is a human or AI commanding an Empire and its Ruler.

GLOBAL.PoisonousConcept.name: Poisonous
GLOBAL.PoisonousConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will become Poisoned for 3 Turn.

GLOBAL.PrimalConcept.name: Primal
GLOBAL.PrimalConcept.description: Has higher Food income.Alter provinces into the Primal Animal's Favored Terrain.

GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept.name: Province Annexation
GLOBAL.ProvinceAnnexationConcept.description:
Province Annexation is the process of expanding your City Domain by building a Province Improvement.
Increase the distance a city can annex provinces by upgrading your town hall.Annex provinces from your Vassal by paying Imperium.Annex ruined provinces from enemy cities by Pillaging them first.

GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept.name: Province
GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept.description:
An area on the World Map marked by borders.

Provinces:Have Province Feature, which determine the Province Improvement that can be built there.Can be annexed to a City by building a Province Improvement within.May contain Resource Node, Pickup, or an Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept.name: Province Feature
GLOBAL.ProvinceFeatureConcept.description:
The natural feature of a Province, such as a forest, river, or grassy plain.

Determines which Province Improvement can be built in a Province.

Note that you can only build Improvements allowed by province features that share the same geography type as the center of the province (Land, Lava, Water, and Void). For example, Ocean only grants the ability to build a Fishing Farm if the center of the province consists of a water feature.

GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept.name: City Vassalage
GLOBAL.PvEVassalConcept.description:
Free Cities can be vassalized by Rulers through Negotiations or by converting an owned or conquered City into a vassal city.

Vassal cities have many advantages:They will share their income and magic materials.They will aid you in wars.They will grant you vision of their domain.Vassal cities may eventually also be integrated into the Ruler's empire.

GLOBAL.RacheqLoreConcept.name: Ra'cheq the Disturbing
GLOBAL.RacheqLoreConcept.description:
Ra'cheq was, as he himself proclaims, but an insect, living in the dirt and feeding on scraps. Until one day the sun eclipsed, the stars darkened and the world was embraced by Urrath. Ra'cheq was the first to crawl from under the rubble and he believes that is why he was Chosen to lead his newly awakened people to greatness.

Ra'cheq's followers believe themselves to be the chosen disciples of Urrath, their dark god. They are prone to violence and jealousy, vying for their god's corrupted love without hesitation to betray even their own kin if their High Corruptor demands it.

GLOBAL.RainaTheGoldenLoreConcept.name: Raina the Golden
GLOBAL.RainaTheGoldenLoreConcept.description:
Raina was a powerful Human queen, who cared more for grandeur than for her subjects. One day an especially scorned and magically adept subject turned the Queen into a toad. Only a life of moderation can break the curse, but since Raina and her people have been toads for generations, this has proven to be an unsurmountable task.

The Cursed Toadlings originated as Raina's most faithful followers. After the first shock of the curse had diminished, they accepted their new existence as semi-aquatic humanoids with valor.

GLOBAL.ReaverConcept.name: Reaver
GLOBAL.ReaverConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Powerful ranged units with a high damage output.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept.name: Reinforcement Rule
GLOBAL.ReinforcementRuleConcept.description:
The Reinforcement Rule allows up to 3 friendly Army that are within 3 hexes of a Combat engagement on the World Map to join one of the combatants.

There are exceptions to this rule. Combat while exploring an Ancient Wonder only allows 1 Army to participate on each side. Furthermore, Army in Location such as Infestation Spawner or City under Siege will not join Combat outside of their Location.

GLOBAL.RiverConcept.name: River
GLOBAL.RiverConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A river runs through this province. Grants +2 Food to Farm built in this province.

GLOBAL.RockyConcept.name: Rocky
GLOBAL.RockyConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Rough lands of exposed rock. A Quarry can be built here.

GLOBAL.RootNodeLoreConcept.name: Root Node
GLOBAL.RootNodeLoreConcept.description: As a Godir's might grows, they begin to gain an almost innate understanding and attunement to places of powerful resonance. Root Nodes are physically manifest confluences of ambient magic present throughout the land. The mightiest of Godir can sense these locations and even manipulate and alter the latent magics therein to reflect their own affinities.

GLOBAL.RoutingConcept.name: Routing
GLOBAL.RoutingConcept.description:
The unit is terrified and is fleeing for its life!

Effects:Ignores zones of control and attacks of opportunity.25% harder to hit with ranged attacks.Moves toward nearest Retreat Point.

GLOBAL.SabertoothTempleConcept.name: Ash Sabertooth Temple
GLOBAL.SabertoothTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with an Ash Sabertooth Den and Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains AshlandsPer Turn, one of the Provinces loses River, Grassland, Swamp, Snow, Ice, Sand, Cavern Floor, Fungus Fields, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.SandConcept.name: Sand
GLOBAL.SandConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A rolling landscape of golden sand. A Hut can be built here.
Cities with Desert Adaptation can build a Farm here instead.

GLOBAL.ScoreVictoryConcept.name: Score Victory
GLOBAL.ScoreVictoryConcept.description:
The Empire with the highest score when the turn limit is reached is victorious.

There are 5 categories which influence your score: Military, Diplomacy, Economy, Expansion and Research. How well you do in each category compared to the other Ruler is what determines your overall score ranking. This is dependent on many variables, these are some examples:Military: Draft income, army power, and killing enemies.Diplomacy: Having allies and Vassal, avoid wars, and don’t cause Grievance.Expansion: Amount of City and Food income.Research: Knowledge and Mana income.Economy: Gold and Production income.

GLOBAL.SealLoreConcept.name: World Seal
GLOBAL.SealLoreConcept.description: [lorefontsize][lorefont]Seals were built by order of the ancient Archons, to protect the Worlds Within from the influences of the Astral Sea... or the other way around. Whoever activates these powerful structures will have full control over anyone who enters or leaves the realm. Thus, the Seals were left heavily guarded. On most worlds, these arcane machinations now lie dormant and forgotten... Unless a powerful Godir finds a way to activate them once more.[/lorefont][/lorefontsize]

GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept.name: Seals Victory
GLOBAL.SealsVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Seals Victory, an Empire needs to accumulate enough points from capturing and holding Seals.

Seals are found throughout the world and can be captured at any time. For each seal you have captured, you gain 1 point each Turn. During this time, Seal defenders will spawn every few Turn at one of your claimed Seals and attempt to take back the Seal from your control. If you control more Seals, they will spawn more often.

The Seals Victory has to be enabled by adding one of the Seal Realm Traits.

GLOBAL.SerenaLoreConcept.name: Serena
GLOBAL.SerenaLoreConcept.description:
Serena is a Wizard of Athla and claimed to be master of life, elves and their eternal trees. After her banishment, Serena was tormented by visions of Worlds destroyed by lesser people. Now rooted with religious conviction, she preaches the eradication of those who would threaten the delicate natural balance.

The Verdant Elves are Serena's most loyal followers. The forests are their home, and they will defend it with all their ageless might. They follow the guidance of the Sylvan Wolf and idolize their eerily beautiful Wizard of Life.

GLOBAL.SerpentTempleConcept.name: Dune Serpent Temple
GLOBAL.SerpentTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Dune Serpent Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains Sand.Per Turn, one of the provinces loses River, Chasm, Grassland, Swamp, Snow, Ice, Ashlands, Cavern Floor, Fungus Fields, and Gloom.

GLOBAL.ShadowCrisisConcept.name: Shadow Crisis
GLOBAL.ShadowCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Shadow weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Shadow Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.SharpConcept.name: Sharp
GLOBAL.SharpConcept.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex will be inflicted with Bleeding for 3 Turn.

GLOBAL.ShiraLoreConcept.name: Shira Snowblood
GLOBAL.ShiraLoreConcept.description:
Shira was born the heir of her people. During her coronation, the Shad'rai invaded her realm, killed her family and cast her into the Astral Void. Shira would have been Lost if not for the aid of Meandor, who guided her to Magehaven, where she joined the Covenant and learned to channel her grief into primal prowess. After a heroic return and a fierce battle against the usurping Shad'rai Godir, she retook her homeland.

Arctic Felines are a proud people who adjusted to the icy tundra of Cantarra, their homeworld. After the return of their long-lost Queen, they followed her through the depths of the Astral Sea and back to avenge their fallen royal family and thwart the plans of the Shad'rai.

GLOBAL.SilverSeasLoreConcept.name: The Silver Seas
GLOBAL.SilverSeasLoreConcept.description:
The legend of the Silver Seas is anchored in the mind of every sailor. Ancient sea shanties tell of a place in the Worlds Within where the Astral Currents converge, with seas so rich that their very waves are made of liquid silver. There, fish with scales of precious metals swim among reefs of pure mana, while the songs of the Maer lull the shores.

Some seafarers theorize that the waves of the Silver Seas lie hidden within Tidolon; others believe that their tides are yet to be found. Still, there are those who claim that this paradise is not a place to find, but a place to seek.

GLOBAL.SingaithLoreConcept.name: Singaith Sky-Shatter
GLOBAL.SingaithLoreConcept.description:
As a rumored descendant of one of the Traitor Kings, Singaith seems to have inherited her ancestors' obsession with power and immortality. Reclusive and self-centered, she values knowledge over any form of other fleeting relationship as she schemes for the glory of her kin to rise again.

Like their ruler Singaith and the Traitor Kings of old, the Galetoads are obsessed with achieving eternal life. Through the magic of the Soul and the knowledge of the Eternal Council, they hope to make their eternal dream a reality... through any means necessary.

GLOBAL.SkonyruLoreConcept.name: Skonyru
GLOBAL.SkonyruLoreConcept.description:
Ever watchful and bold, Grand Vindicator Skonyru judges those who threaten the meek, descending upon them with grim anger. Said to originate from a forgotten kingdom in which the larger and smaller races lived together in harmony, Skonyru is determined to carry on the legacy of his forebears—a noble mission which earned him the allegiance of the Graceful Judges.

Since Skonyru saved them from the pitiless forges of Khir Uranon, the Vigilant Smithlings have been his loyal and dexterous followers. Through their special bond, the inner fire of the ogrekin was invoked within them and they became gifted in the carving of runes, making their formidable smithworks able to withstand almost any kind of harm.

GLOBAL.SlowingConcept.name: Slowing
GLOBAL.SlowingConcept.description:
The Combat Speed cost for moving through this hex is doubled for non-flying units.

Shock Unit attacking from this hex have their Charge attacks blocked.

GLOBAL.SnowConcept.name: Snow
GLOBAL.SnowConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Cold lands covered in snow. A Hut can be built here.
Arctic-adapted factions can build a Farm here instead.

GLOBAL.SoulConcept.name: Soul
GLOBAL.SoulConcept.description:
Souls are the concentrated essence of living beings.

Used for:Producing Undead Unit.Casting certain Shadow Spell.Unlock Souls by researching certain Shadow Tome.

GLOBAL.SpellJammerConcept.name: Spell Jammer
GLOBAL.SpellJammerConcept.description:
The Spell Jammer is a Special Province Improvement that can be built in City that are at least City Tier 3.

When built, has the following effects:Enemies cannot target World Map Spell in this Domain.-10 Mana.Counts as a Conduit.

GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept.name: Overcharged Spell
GLOBAL.SpellOverchargeConcept.description: Combat Spell may gain overcharge, granting them increased effectiveness based on the type of spell: Damage Spell gain +25% damage. Healing Spell gain +25% healing. Buff Spell gain +1 Bolstered Resistance. Debuff Spell gain +1 Sundered Resistance. Combat Enchantment allow another spell to be cast that turn. Combat Summon Spell gain +2 Strengthened.

GLOBAL.SpellUpkeepConcept.name: Spell Upkeep
GLOBAL.SpellUpkeepConcept.description: Spell Upkeep is paid each Turn on the World Map. Each spell has its own Mana upkeep.

GLOBAL.SpiderTempleConcept.name: Tunneling Spider Temple
GLOBAL.SpiderTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Tunneling Spider Den and Underground Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains Mushroom Forest

GLOBAL.StalagmitesConcept.name: Stalagmites
GLOBAL.StalagmitesConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A formation of mineral and rock that rises from the cavern floor. A Quarry can be built here.

GLOBAL.SundrenLoreConcept.name: Sundren
GLOBAL.SundrenLoreConcept.description:
Curious and clever, Sundren was the second-born child, daughter of Queen Julia and her royal consort. She founded the Torchbearers as one of the few leaders ever to unite High Elves with their Dark-Elf kindred... But after the assassination of her brother, and later the death of her father, Sundren finds her noble heart growing dark with a lust for vengeance.

Mended Torchbearers are the kindred and followers of Sundred and her dream of a life filled with a deeply heroic meaning. Many kindred were once jaded by age and propriety, while others thirsted for bloody revenge. Sundren gave them all a much more thrilling reason to live.

GLOBAL.SurplusConcept.name: Surplus
GLOBAL.SurplusConcept.description:
Knowledge, Production or Draft that is left over once research, construction or recruitment is completed.

This surplus will automatically be spent on the next item that you choose to research, build or recruit.

Surplus can only be kept for a single Turn

GLOBAL.SylvaniLaurelLoreConcept.name: Sylvani Laurel
GLOBAL.SylvaniLaurelLoreConcept.description:
Sylvani was born and raised in the capital city of her Elven tribe. With her talent for magic and love for nature she inherited her title from her grandmother after she fell to undead forces.

The Auldweald Elves are one of the oldest Elven tribes on the World of their namesake. They carve their history in their own bodies, and in the trees around them. Thereby, both bark and skin share the same legends.

GLOBAL.SyronSovereignLoreConcept.name: Nykareth
GLOBAL.SyronSovereignLoreConcept.description:
Nykareth was once a Syron, one of the most zealous fighters of the Gloomwatch. Through the Ages, her hatred for the Umbral Abyss began to consume her, and she started to see Urrath's corruption even within the light of creation itself. Shunned for her erratic behavior, Nykareth has become obsessed with smiting those she deems corrupted... But the grounds of her judgments are unclear to all but her.

The Veilstriders are Nykareth's most loyal soldiers, priding themselves on being the last bastion of true faith that stands against the torrent of the Umbral Abyss. They see their ruler's physical transformation as a blessing of the Archons, and as proof that their path is the truly righteous one.

GLOBAL.TeleporterConcept.name: Teleporter
GLOBAL.TeleporterConcept.description:
A Province Improvement which enables an Army to teleport from one teleporter to another.

-10 Mana.

GLOBAL.TempestLoreConcept.name: Tempest
GLOBAL.TempestLoreConcept.description:
He arrives in a cyclone of lightning and claims himself to be the Master of Dragons. Few dare to question that claim, for Tempest is indeed known to walk among these primal beings. Even more eccentric and erratic now than he was before being banished to the Void, Tempest's mind is like a brewing storm.

The Draconians were the result of a rare collaboration between wizard and Dragon. As a reward for this endeavor, Tempest claimed half of the resulting hatchlings and has ruled them ever since. Now, after following their master through the Astral Sea itself, the Stormborn Draconians almost share more kinship with Tempest than the Dragons they originate from.

GLOBAL.TephradenirLoreConcept.name: Tephradenir
GLOBAL.TephradenirLoreConcept.description:
Tephradenir is an Elder Dragon who was born together with her world. Mountains and dales formed under her care. After her task was done, she slept... Until she was awakened once more, only to see her world filled with vermin who change and destroy her precious creations. Enraged, she rises to take vengeance upon those who deem her work "imperfect".

A group of primitive cave dwellers hid from Dwarven miners and found an Elder Dragon who slept at the bottom. When she awakened and destroyed the Dwarves—and a big part of the world above—the cave dwellers named her their wrathful goddess. Generations later, few question the decisions of their primal patron.

GLOBAL.ThrallConcept.name: Thrall
GLOBAL.ThrallConcept.description:
Thralls are enslaved people or creatures that can be used as currency for special ritual Spell.

Eldritch Sovereign gain thralls by defeating enough enemies in battle or with spells like Enthrall Population.

Elder Vampire gain thralls by building the Vampire Castle: Foundation.

GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.name: Free Trade Agreement
GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.description: Both Ruler allow each other to establish Trade Route between each other's City.

GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept.name: Trade Route
GLOBAL.TradeRouteConcept.description:
A connection between a City and an Outpost or other City, granting the origin city where it was created Trade Route Income based on the target it is connected to.

Cities can establish a Trade Route by spending Draft, the cost increasing with the type of target and the amount of movement needed to reach it.

Only a certain number of Trade Routes can be active per City, this cap can be increased via City Structure.

GLOBAL.TradeRouteIncomeConcept.name: Trade Route Income
GLOBAL.TradeRouteIncomeConcept.description: Trade Route income given to the City depends on the target:Outpost - All income from the outpost's Domain. Free City - A percentage of all their income increasing with their Diplomatic State.Foreign City - A large percentage of their Gold and Mana.

GLOBAL.TraitorKingCultLoreConcept.name: Sons of the Kjörnoe
GLOBAL.TraitorKingCultLoreConcept.description: Tempted by the promise of dark power, the Sons of the Kjörnoe worship the fallen Traitor Kings of Myrrida as gods. Searching for artifacts imbued with the Souls of their deceased masters, the Sons of the Kjörnoe study the forbidden soulcurses of the Traitor Kings, claiming the lives of the innocent to empower their vile rituals.

GLOBAL.TreatyConcept.name: Treaty
GLOBAL.TreatyConcept.description:
An agreement between two Empire where resources may be exchanged or diplomatic permissions are granted.

A Wizard's Bond needs to be established for more advanced Treaties and to achieve an Alliance.

Treaties last indefinitely but may be broken manually or through declaring War. Breaking treaties is considered an evil act and will give the opposing Ruler a Grievance.

GLOBAL.TugrumLoreConcept.name: Tugrum Hammerhall
GLOBAL.TugrumLoreConcept.description:
Dwarves labor to impress their First Guardian. Tugrum Hammerhall shows only that she is never quite appeased. Therefore, stubborn Dwarven men with their stubborn Dwarven wills contest her disapproving brow. One wonders when they will notice that she is secretly quite proud.

The strength of the mountains embodies the Mountain Dwarves. They thrive in the crevices, cliffsides, and among jagged precipices where they can work the hard rock breaking the soft level lands.

GLOBAL.TurielLoreConcept.name: Turiel Tolarim
GLOBAL.TurielLoreConcept.description:
A mighty Orc whose honor-bound convictions match his prodigious strength, Turiel was the first Wizard King to ascend to Godirhood. He appears as a mighty and masked Orc, a bastion of stoic ferocity clad in indomitable armor and wielding brutal weaponry. Ever oath-bound to the Archon in guarding Grexolis, he holds honor and duty in highest esteem.

Turiel leads the mighty Onmar, fierce Ascended Orcs who aid him in a duty shared and who have, in return, been blessed by the Archon. Their minds are guarded against the insidious whispers of the banished souls they hold eternal vigil over.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept.name: Umbral Dwelling
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingConcept.description:
Umbral Dwellings are a type of Dwelling inhabited by Umbral Demons that can only be found in the Umbral Abyss.
Umbral Dwellings are always considered Pure Evil and will have positive relations with other Evil Empires and negative relations with Good Empires.You cannot assign a Whispering Stone to them.To improve Allegiance, you will be asked to make sacrifices during random events and via the Boost Allegiance action.Upon reaching a Eldritch Pact, you can purchase unique Spell and other bonuses to benefit from Gloom terrain.Umbral Dwellings slowly alter terrain in and adjacent to their Domain into GloomUmbral Dwellings cannot be vassalized or conquered. Instead, they are destroyed upon being captured.Umbral Dwellings are led by unique <<Umbral Tyrant>> Hero who cannot be recruited or converted.

GLOBAL.UmbralTaintHazard.name: Umbral Taint
GLOBAL.UmbralTaintHazard.description: Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:Lose -5 Morale.Become Decaying for 3 Turn.Units immune to Umbral Malady aren't affected.

GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept.name: Unit Enchantment
GLOBAL.UnitEnchantmentConcept.description:
A type of Spell that grants a bonus to a specific group of your Unit while it is active.

These spells:Affect both existing and newly created units.Increase the Upkeep of affected units.Can be canceled at any time by the caster.

GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept.name: Urvatogh
GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept.description:
To some, he is the divine progenitor who sired perfection into existence through the Pureblood Archvampires; while to others he is but a mythological monster who once terrorized the Astral Sea in a bygone age. Yet to one alone, he shall forever be remembered as the gallant Pale Prince of Roses...

Urvatogh the First Vampire, Blood Emperor Eternal of the Crimson Reign, and Deathless God who died yet rose again. His Grand Dominion of Drevanya once spread far and wide, until deepest betrayal sealed him away within a crypt, to fade beyond memory into myth. Here, he slumbers in perpetuity, though certain cults tell that he shall one night rise again to bring about a coveted reckoning of blood.

His Eternal Attendants are but animated remnants of a now long-forgotten race. They once served the family of the Pale Prince of Roses, back in brighter days.

GLOBAL.ValeryLoreConcept.name: Valery of House Avernos
GLOBAL.ValeryLoreConcept.description:
A warlord of high principles and standards, Valery of House Avernos represents the best the fallen Commonwealth once stood for. When dedicated to a cause, her loyalty is beyond question, though after the Shad'rai invasion on Athla she yet has to find a new cause worthy of her vow.

The soldiers of the Commonwealth were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the Astral Sea. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.

GLOBAL.VantagePointConcept.name: Vantage Point
GLOBAL.VantagePointConcept.description: Units at this location gain +1 Range and ignore Obscured on their ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.VaultsphereLoreConcept.name: Vaultsphere
GLOBAL.VaultsphereLoreConcept.description: A mysterious dome-like structure built by the Ancient Krazura. Inside, a dormant environment dwells in magical stasis, as the last glimpse of a world long lost. While the original purpose of the Vaultsphere became forgotten with its creators, many aspiring factions have attempted to use the realm fragments sealed inside as experimental chambers of their own.

GLOBAL.VeryLowMoraleConcept.name: Very Low
GLOBAL.VeryLowMoraleConcept.description:
The unit is despairing and close to breaking.

Effects:Fumble Chance: 40%.

GLOBAL.WaterRockyConcept.name: Water Rocky
GLOBAL.WaterRockyConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

A series of rocky outcroppings trailing into the sea. A water Quarry can be built here.

GLOBAL.WepwatepLoreConcept.name: Wepwatep
GLOBAL.WepwatepLoreConcept.description:
Wepwatep was a zealous priestess of the Dune Serpent. So deep was her love for the Primal Spirit, that in an elaborate ritual she had herself covered in snakes and entombed below the shifting sands of the Alkothan Desert. When she emerged, the golden markings of the Dune Serpent were forever etched in her body and soul.

Sandfangs see wealth as a great virtue and adorn themselves in gold and jewelry to honor the Dune Serpent. Priests create pendants of the bones of the dead, for Sandfangs believe it is a great honor to wear the fangs of their forefathers on their bodies.

GLOBAL.WerlacLoreConcept.name: Werlac of Insaldur
GLOBAL.WerlacLoreConcept.description:
The best villains consider themselves heroes. While a simple servant of Meandor, Werlac organized a zealous cult to bring back the banished Wizard Kings, without concern for the cataclysms it unleashed. When he found his reward unsatisfying, he started his search for other ancient powers to revere.

The Shadowborn Elves are wandering cultists, adept at unveiling secrets in the weirdest spaces between worlds. They follow their cult leader through the shadows of the Astral Sea with the ease of pirates on a vast mysterious ocean, looking for a befitting higher power to worship and unleash upon the worlds.

GLOBAL.WightbornConcept.name: Wightborn
GLOBAL.WightbornConcept.description: Gives the target race immortality beyond life, granting them:The Undead unit type.Life Steal, which restores Temporary Hit Point upon each attack.

GLOBAL.WizardSyronLoreConcept.name: Aeri Kyastir
GLOBAL.WizardSyronLoreConcept.description:
As a direct descendant of the first Syrons, Aeri grew up in reverence of the history of the Gloomwatch. Yet, as her talents as a Wizard grew, her Torment of Shadows made her question her assigned burden as a cosmic protector. Instead, she decided to offer sanctuary to those who choose simpler lives... Though in the Astral Sea, that in itself is a challenge.

The Free Syrons consist mainly of veterans, and people who declined the duty and honor of the Gloomwatch in favor of a calmer life on the Worlds Within. Yet, when threatened, they will stand their ground next to any other battle-hardened warrior.

GLOBAL.WokoLoreConcept.name: Woko Ulang
GLOBAL.WokoLoreConcept.description:
When his name is whispered on a realm, everyone starts to prepare for war: Woko Ulang, the Apex Slayer, invokes fear even in the most ferocious warriors, for his blade strikes true and his heart knows no respite. After he slew the Elder Jade Dragon Shoqwuna on his home world, Woko Ulang started to travel the Astral Sea, seeking opponents worth striking down.

The Warring Jungleborn are the relentless tide which Woko Ulang unleashes on the realms he enters. They are agile fighters, jumping from liana to liana, and they will carry the drums of war to anyone unable to flee their rapid expansion in time.

GLOBAL.WolfTempleConcept.name: Sylvan Wolf Temple
GLOBAL.WolfTempleConcept.description: Annexed Province with a Sylvan Wolf Den and Surface Provinces within a radius equal to the city tier:Grant +5 Mana.Per Turn, one of the Provinces gains Forest.

GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept.name: Wonderstone
GLOBAL.WonderStoneConcept.description: Wonderstone is a resource uniquely used by the Architect to construct and improve Monument. Wonderstone is gained from:Magic Material.Using Surveyors to survey unsurveyed provinces that contain Magic Material.

GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept.name: World Map Casting Point
GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept.description:
Represent your ability to channel the powerful magical energies needed to cast Spell on the World Map.

They are refilled at the start of each Turn. If a spell needs more casting points than you have, then the spell will take multiple turns to cast.

GLOBAL.XanderaLoreConcept.name: Xandera the Phoenix
GLOBAL.XanderaLoreConcept.description:
With scarlet wings and piercing emerald eyes, Xandera the Phoenix signals her readiness to the potential enemies of her people—which means to everyone. As the Yukara of the Krazura she is believed to be the current reincarnation of the first Krazuran Yukara, possessing great knowledge and wisdom. But the recollections of millennia of hardships and betrayal have rendered her cautious and unforgiving towards outsiders.

Knowledgeable and gifted in the arcane, the Krazura still resemble their distant ancestors in many ways. However ages of isolation within Grexolis have dulled their astral instincts and eroded their civilization, to the point that only a minority of Manuhari's inhabitants still call themselves Krazura.

GLOBAL.XetevacaLoreConcept.name: Xetevaca Worldshaper
GLOBAL.XetevacaLoreConcept.description:
Xetevaca was named by the excavators who found her after she was cast into the dark depths as a newborn. Her charm and popularity was deemed dangerous by her ruling empress, resulting in the banishment of Xetevaca and her loyal followers. She emerged from the Astral Void as a Godir.

The Underground Disciples originated as a small community within a vast empire, but their trust in Xetevaca caused them to take a leap of faith into the Astral Void itself. Those who survived emerged with her and now follow her in search of a new home.

GLOBAL.XornLoreConcept.name: Xorn the Disciplined
GLOBAL.XornLoreConcept.description:
Xorn used to be a mercenary commander, hired by the former Elven Court on Athla. As the Umbral Demons invaded, Xorn found himself fighting alongside former enemies. Ever stoic and true to his name, it is said he ascended when he fell holding off an Eldritch Sovereign and its armies—an act of bravery still lauded among his people.

Originating from a mercenary army, the Othrakar have since developed a culture and morality of their own. Their myths and legends consist mostly of acts of heroism and overcoming great odds, which is also why they hold their leader in such high reverence.

GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept.name: Yaka
GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept.description:
Stare into the flames long enough and a single name will come to your lips. A god of fire. Only a god of fire can live within the raging inferno, able to master its unpredictable flow of destruction. He is quick to punish those that do not give him rightful reverence, for only creatures that can withstand waves of unrelenting heat are worthy to serve the great Godir, Yaka.

Remembering a time when felines were worshiped as god-kin, the Firebrand Predators serve Yaka with a zeal that he has not seen for generations. Yaka dotes upon his Tigran followers, for he remembers how his past servants abandoned him. Together they seek to build an unquenchable inferno.

GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept.name: Ydgaard Worldbender
GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept.description:
Like the Void Stone that replaced his heart through a macabre covenant for power, Ydgaard's desires run to the cold and shiny. A grizzled and mighty Dwarf whose greed is as impressive as his beard, he covets wealth and resources above all. The great jewel that adorns his left eye socket in place of an eyeball (also part of the aforementioned pact) is a stark reflection of how he sees the world.

Ydgaard rules over a race of mole-like beings known as the Grave Underlings. It is surmised that their form was chosen due in part to their poor eyesight, that they may never covet their master's wealth. Likewise, their natural predilection to excavation of the planet's riches allow them to ever increase the size of Ydgaard's own hoard.

GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept.name: Zaethyl Silverleaf
GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept.description:
After the Dragons breathed out the worlds, and the Archons fixed them to stars, they called the first ones to lead those who will put down the storm, quench the fires and quicken the seas. They call for the Wild Guardian, Zaethyl.

The immortal First Elves live refined lives cultivated by millennia of patient thought and arcane mastery. Entrusted with arcane mysteries and guardians of creation magic, they form worlds rife with life. Sometimes perceived as intolerant elites, they have little patience for short-term mortal concerns.

GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept.name: Zone of Control
GLOBAL.ZoneOfControlConcept.description: A unit's Zone of Control is the three hexes in front of it.The Zone of Control blocks enemy movement and determines where the unit can perform a Retaliation Attack.Going into Defense Mode extends the Zone of Control to all adjacent hexes.
